title: Tender Manager
description:
Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission;
  • Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders;
  • Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO;
  • Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements;
  • Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk;
  • Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective;
  • Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation;
  • In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself.

As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together.

You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer

That distinction is important.

At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders.

Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered.

You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time.

You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority.

Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation.

Building the Tender Desk

In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon.

A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined.

Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management.

A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities.
  • Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment;
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines;
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority;
  • The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective;
  • Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage;
  • Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling;
  • Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working;

Who are you?

You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you.

You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid.

You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough.

At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you?

title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals:

  • Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten;
  • Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren);
  • Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie;
  • Hartkleplijden.

Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend.

De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie.

Over ons: onze zorg klopt!

We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol.

We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog.

Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie;
  • Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen);
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende:

  • Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring;
  • Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW;
  • Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht;
  • 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer;
  • Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past;
  • Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. En voordeel op jouw ziektekostenverzekering met onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

description:
Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager

Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders;
  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;
  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;
  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;
  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;
  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Hengelo, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

*Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een jong, betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen.

title: HR Business Partner (m/w/d) Führungskräftebetreuung
description:
Über MOTOR Ai

Wir sind MOTOR Ai. Unsere Mission ist es, autonomes Fahren der Stufe 4 in Deutschland und darüber hinaus Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen. Durch die Kombination modernster KI mit dem Fachwissen unseres multidisziplinären Teams sind wir bereit, die erste Lösung ihrer Art in Deutschland auf den Markt zu bringen, die für die Zulassung auf europäischen Straßen qualifiziert ist. Seit 2017 verfolgen wir unbeirrt ein einziges Ziel: eine Zukunft zu gestalten, die bereits in Bewegung ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für unsere Führungskräfte und berätst sie zu Führung, Teamstruktur, Feedback, Entwicklung und arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen

  • Du steuerst Performance- und Konfliktfälle von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung

  • Du koordinierst die Schnittstellen zwischen Teams, Führungskräften und HR und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss

  • Du verantwortest den Recruiting-Prozess für Teamleads: Gemeinsam mit den Hiring Managern entwickelst du die Recruiting-Strategie je Position, setzt Prioritäten und steuerst unseren Recruiter

  • Du organisierst 30-Tage- und Executive-Feedbackgespräche, wertest sie aus und leitest Maßnahmen ab

  • Perspektivisch entwickelst und managest du Workshops zum Thema Führung

  • Du übernimmst die anfallenden administrativen HR-Aufgaben

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine einschlägige Ausbildung bzw. ein Studium. Wichtiger ist uns aber deine Berufserfahrung im Personalbereich und deine Art zu arbeiten

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als HR Business Partner oder in einer vergleichbaren beratenden HR-Rolle, idealerweise in einem wachsenden Tech-Umfeld

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Führungskräften, auch in schwierigen Gesprächen

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Recruiting- und im Aufsetzen neuer Prozesse

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Personio (oder einem vergleichbaren HRIS), Claude und anderen Tools

  • Englisch und Deutsch auf B2/C1-Niveau

  • Bereitschaft, 4 Tage pro Woche onsite zu arbeiten

Ein Plus:

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-Teams

Deine Benefits

  • Dein Aufgabenbereich ermöglicht dir, deine eigene Handschrift einzubringen und so die Strukturen und das Arbeitsklima der Firma von Grund auf mitzugestalten

  • Wir bieten dir eine motivierende Vergütung und eine Beteiligung am Monatsticket

  • Wir sind mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbar in unserem Büro am Humboldthain

  • Dynamisches, innovatives und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Du erhältst 28 Tage Jahresurlaub und zusätzlich schenken wir dir am 24. und 31. Dezember jeweils einen halben Tag

  • Teamgeist wird bei uns großgeschrieben - auf regelmäßigen Team- und Firmenevents feiern wir gemeinsame Erfolge

Vielfalt, Eigenverantwortung und Sinnhaftigkeit in einem spannenden Team sind dir wichtig? Dann hilft uns die Zukunft von morgen schon heute zu gestalten. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

In unseren neuen Räumlichkeiten legen wir großen Wert darauf, uns persönlich kennenzulernen und unsere Vision gemeinsam voranzutreiben. Unser internationales Team wächst und arbeitet zusammen an dieser spannenden Mission. Die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort ist für uns der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

  • Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. You will standardize data patterns (sharding, replication, DR) across hundreds of terabytes in DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena, while leading high-stakes, zero-downtime database migrations and deprecations.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration at Scale: You quickly grasp complex technical topics, distributed systems trade-offs, and applied mathematics.   • Technical Leadership & Organizational Leverage: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You drive alignment across squads through RFCs and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define org-level SLIs/SLOs, sponsor major technical migrations, and mentor Senior engineers across an international engineering team.

  • Du vereinbarst kontinuierlich qualifizierte Termine, und deine Pipeline ist eine, mit der unsere Account Executives wirklich gerne arbeiten

  • Du kennst Produkt, Markt und Kunden so gut, dass du Discovery Calls eigenständig führen kannst

title: Senior Seeker Systems Engineer (EO/IR & Radar) (f/m/d)
description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Senior Seeker Systems Engineer (EO/IR & Radar) to define and develop the sensing capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems. You will lead the selection, integration, and optimization of onboard sensors, including daylight cameras, thermal imagers, radar, and other targeting payloads, ensuring reliable target detection, tracking, and engagement.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

  1. Lead new EO/IR sensor designs in collaboration with hardware and systems engineering teams.

  2. Evaluate and select EO, IR, radar, laser, and multi-sensor solutions.

  3. Develop sensor fusion, target detection, tracking, and classification algorithms.

  4. Specify sensor performance requirements, including range, field of view, stabilization, and SWaP constraints.

  5. Drive integration of sensors into gimbals, payloads, and autonomy systems.

  6. Conduct trade studies, system performance analyses, and supplier evaluations.

  7. Support in ground testing, validation, and flight trials.


  1. Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Mechatronics, or similar.

  2. Experience in missile seekers, guided weapons, EO/IR payloads, targeting systems, gimbals, ISR sensors, or defense electronics.

  3. Strong knowledge of:

    • Electro-optical (EO) cameras

    • Thermal / IR imaging systems

    • Radar and RF sensing

    • Sensor fusion and target tracking

  4. Experience translating mission requirements into sensor architectures and payload designs.

  5. Hands-on mindset with the ability to take ownership of critical technical decisions.

Ideal Candidate?

You have worked on missile programs, loitering munitions, ISR payloads, targeting systems, or stabilized gimbals and understand how to answer key questions such as:

  • What sensor suite is required for the mission?

  • EO, thermal, radar, or multi-mode seeker?

  • How should sensors be integrated into the autonomy stack?

  • How can detection performance be maximized within strict size, weight, and power constraints?

You'll play a key role in shaping the sensing and targeting capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

title: Senior Partner Manager - DACH
description:
About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together.

  • Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget

  • Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits

  • Country-specific holiday policies apply

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • Home office budget and allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home should be autonomously run and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end.

Our landlords hand us their most valuable asset, often on a guaranteed rent, so how well a property is run is our product. Property Managers own every property after the tenant moves in: compliance, maintenance, rent, renewals and the relationship with the landlord and tenant.

We've raised a $4m pre-seed and are a small, high-agency team, growing revenue at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to keep service quality ahead of that growth.

 

How we manage

We run portfolios, not inboxes. Every property has an owner who knows its compliance dates, its contractors, its rent position and its tenant by name. Problems get fixed before the landlord or tenant has to chase.

We're honest about what's ours to fix and what isn't. Repairs are triaged on liability and urgency, quoted against evidence and closed out with proof. AI handles the triage, chasing and admin, so a PM's time goes on decisions, contractors and people.

When a guaranteed property sits empty or arrears build, it's our money on the line, so a PM thinks like an owner.

 

What we're looking for

  • Experience. ~2+ years running a residential lettings portfolio as a property manager, at an agency, BTR operator or block manager.

  • Working knowledge of landlord compliance: gas safety, EICR, EPC, smoke and CO alarms, deposit protection, Right to Rent, HMO and selective licensing.

  • Up to date on the Renters' Rights Act 2025 and what it changes for possession, rent increases and repairs.

  • A track record of managing contractors on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset. You build the process when there isn't one yet, and you want to grow with the business.

 

Nice to have

  • ARLA Propertymark qualification (or working towards it).

  • Experience with Fixflo or similar maintenance tools.

  • HMO or guaranteed-rent portfolio experience in London.

 

How you work

  • Hyper-focus on detail. A missed certificate date or an unprotected deposit is a fine, not a typo.

  • Ownership mentality. You own the property's outcome from start to end, without being chased.

  • Commercial judgement. You know when to repair, when to replace, and who should pay.

  • Communication clarity. Calm and direct with tenants, landlords and contractors, especially when the news is bad.

  • Pace. You close issues fast and keep a portfolio moving while it grows.

title: Internal Control Officer
description:
What is Finary?

We are on a mission to give power back to investors. Great financial guidance has always existed, it just came with a minimum net worth. We're changing that by building the AI-powered one-stop shop for investing, where you can track your assets, manage your budget, invest, and learn. One simple, ambitious idea drives us: put a private banker in everyone's pocket.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use.

Why now?

A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. To fuel that, we raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator, and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman), and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise).

In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

The opportunity

More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination.

Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory, and now control. Each role covers every licence. You'll be the one who checks that what we say we do is what we actually do.

What you'll do

  • Execute the permanent control plan: about 40 controls a year, 3 to 5 days each, across all four licences.

  • Design each test and run it yourself: population, sampling, test steps, evidence.

  • Write findings and recommendations based on evidence, and review them with the teams concerned, taking their remarks into account.

  • Improve the control plan: keep regulatory references up to date, raise the quality of each control, and run spot controls, validated by the Head of Compliance, when the compliance team detects a risk to prioritise.

  • Follow every recommendation until it is closed: re-test, and escalate what is overdue.

  • Automate as much as possible: with data and AI tools, from testing full populations to keeping the control library current, so your time goes to judgement.

  • Control only, by design: no operational tasks. Your variable pay depends only on the quality of your controls and how much of the plan is executed.

What we're looking for

  • You've spent 6+ years in permanent control, regulatory consulting or inspection in financial services, and you executed the controls yourself.

  • Your working papers have been through a regulator inspection or a periodic control (internal audit).

  • You've tested controls in at least two types of licensed institution: crypto-asset service provider, investment firm, payment or e-money institution, insurance intermediary. Investment firm experience is not required.

  • You test with data and AI tools, and you've already automated parts of your control work. This is a must, not a plus.

  • You base findings on evidence, and you take the business's remarks into account when reviewing them.

  • You plan and deliver on your own, following the control plan and risk map: there is no control framework team around you yet.

  • Native-level French and professional English.

This role is not for you if you'd rather run operations, you need a GRC tool and a team before you can start, or you see controls as boxes to tick.

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: executing controls and getting them closed.

What we offer

  • 65K to 80K EUR total package (fixed + variable), depending on level, plus BSPCE

  • Reporting to the Head of Compliance, in a team of five

  • Based in Paris: on site at least 2 days a week (3 days remote maximum). Permanent contract (CDI), start in Q1 2027

  • MacBook Pro and every AI subscription you need

  • Health coverage with Alan, and a learning budget

How we work

  • Regulated by choice: we chose the licences years before they became mandatory

  • English is our operating language; your regulatory work will be in French

  • Our process: screen with our talent team (45 min), take-home case (about 3h), case debrief with the Head of Compliance, team meeting, founder meeting. About three weeks end to end.

Interviews

Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call.

description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.

GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.

Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.

Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :

·       La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.

·       Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.

·       L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.

·       Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.

·       L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.

·       La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.

·       La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.

 

Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description:
About this position

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Your tasks:

  • Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

  • Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

  • Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

  • Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

  • Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

  • Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

  • Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

  • Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

  • Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

  • Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

  • Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Work permit

Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland

Your path forward

If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients.

title: Founding Marketing Manager
description:
Important: this role is based in our offices in Chiasso, Switzerland, and is open to EU citizens only.

About Anthropos

Anthropos is the Enterprise AI transformation platform. We help companies map, verify, and develop the skills of their workforce with AI Simulations, AI Labs, AI Interviews, and our AI Academy. Enterprises in energy, transportation, and technology use us to answer a question no HR system can: what can our people actually do, and are they ready for AI?

We are a global team that has been building in the skills and assessment space for more than a decade. Most of us built and scaled a previous company in this exact market to a successful exit. Now we are doing it again, with AI at the core.

The role

You will be our first marketing hire, and you will own marketing.

There is no playbook to inherit and no team to delegate to on day one. You will work side by side with our CEO and founder and with the sales team, from our offices in Chiasso, and your job is to build the machine that grows our pipeline, our brand, and ultimately our revenue.

This is an operator role, not a strategy-only role. You will write the copy, ship the campaign, run the event, look at the data, and decide what to do next. If that excites you more than managing an agency, keep reading.

What you'll do

  • Demand generation. Design and run campaigns that put qualified enterprise buyers (CHROs, HR and Engineering leaders, CTOs) in front of our sales team. You own the pipeline number with them.
  • SEO and GEO. Grow our organic presence on search engines and inside AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity). Being found by AI is as important to us as being found by Google, and we are early enough that you can win here.
  • Events. Plan and run our presence at conferences, executive dinners, and our own events, end to end: pick them, organize them, work the room, follow up.
  • Content and brand. Shape how Anthropos sounds and looks in public: website, blog, LinkedIn, email, sales materials. Make the brand feel as good as the product.
  • Measurement. Instrument what you do, report on what worked, kill what didn't, and double down fast.
  • Structure. As things start working, turn them into repeatable processes and eventually into a team you help build.

Who you are

  • An entrepreneur at heart who knows marketing. You treat the function like your own business: you spot opportunities, act without waiting for permission, and own the outcome. Behind that instinct is real experience: years of generalist marketing in startups across demand gen, content, events, and product marketing, so you know which levers actually move pipeline.
  • Someone who gets things done. You are extremely operational. You default to doing, not briefing someone else to do, and you bring results fast. You like being measured on them.
  • An expert with Claude Code, or a heavy daily user of it. We use AI in a very advanced way across the whole company, and we expect marketing to work the same way: producing at a pace and volume a traditional marketer can't match. This is a real requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Confident in a startup that moves very fast. We change direction quickly, the bar is high, and some days are stressful. In exchange, you will learn more in a year here than in five anywhere else. You need to genuinely want that trade.
  • A big risk-taker. You launch things that might fail, test channels nobody assigned you, and own the result either way.
  • Not looking for a nine-to-five. This is a startup job, and we are honest about what that means: we work quite a lot. If what you want is a predictable 9-to-5, this is not the right fit, and that's okay. If you want the intensity because of what you get to build, own, and learn, you will feel at home.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English, at a near-perfect level. Most of what you produce will be read by an international audience. Italian is a plus.
  • An EU citizen. Hiring non-EU citizens in Switzerland requires more time and we cannot currently afford that.
  • Able to work from our offices in Chiasso, Ticino. We work in person, with one remote day per week (Thursdays). You need to live in, or be ready to move to, an area where you can commute to Chiasso every day: the provinces of Como, Milan or Varese (Italy), or Switzerland. Relocation support is available where possible.

Not an EU citizen, but sure you are the right person for this role? Write to us before you apply, at ----- and tell us why. We will consider strong candidates.

What you'll get

  • CHF 42,000–50,000 per year, plus a very generous stock package. We'd rather be upfront: this is a startup salary paired with real ownership in the company, and the upside grows with the business you help build.
  • Relocation support, where available, if you are not already in the area.
  • The ability to grow very fast. You start as our first marketing hire; if you deliver, you build and lead the function. No queue of people ahead of you.
  • A direct working relationship with the founder and the sales team: short feedback loops, no layers.
  • The tools to work like it's the AI era: Claude Code, our own platform, and budget for what you need.

How we hire

We use our own product. The process: apply → complete an AI Simulation built for this role → meet the team → offer. It is fast, and you will experience exactly what we sell.

  • Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports.

  • Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

BAAN · FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM

THERMELEON | Richting klimaatneutrale glastuinbouw

Ons product – de Thermeleon Warmtebatterij – is een innovatieve etmaalbuffer voor kassen. Het verbetert de energie-efficiëntie van kassen door de overtollige warmte strategisch te hergebruiken tijdens de dag-nachtcyclus. Zo verlagen we het aardgasgebruik substantieel en is er een hogere klimaatgelijkheid over de kas heen. In deze rol ben jij de technische schakel tussen ons Sales-team en onze klanten (telers). Je beantwoordt zelfstandig de meerderheid van de technische vragen die vanuit sales binnenkomen, en zorgt ervoor dat alleen de complexere vraagstukken bij het Tech-team terechtkomen. Je valt onder Operations en werkt nauw samen met zowel Sales als het technische team.

Tasks

WAT GA JE DOEN

Je bent eerstelijns technisch aanspreekpunt voor vragen die vanuit Sales binnenkomen

Je vertaalt technische vraagstukken naar heldere, begrijpelijke antwoorden voor klanten en salescollega's

Je handelt zelfstandig het grootste deel van de technische vragen af die vanuit sales binnenkomen

Je herkent en prioriteert complexere technische issues en zet deze gestructureerd door naar het Tech-team

Je ondersteunt Sales bij offertes, demo's en klantgesprekken waar technische diepgang nodig is

Je denkt actief mee over hoe het technische proces en de klantvraag beter op elkaar aansluiten

Requirements

WAT WE ZOEKEN
Je hebt een technische studie-achtergrond (bijvoorbeeld Werktuigbouwkunde, Natuurkunde, Chemical Engineering of vergelijkbaar)

Je hebt affiniteit met klantcontact en commercieel inzicht

Je bent een sterke communicator die technische inhoud helder over kan brengen aan een niet-technisch publiek

Je bent zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht, en schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en klantrelatie

Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol (bijvoorbeeld Technical Sales, Asset Reliability Specialist, Application Engineer) is een pré

Passie voor duurzame innovatie en hardware

Benefits

WAT WIJ BIEDEN

Je bouwt het data-platform vanaf de grond af aan, met veel eigen inbreng in tooling en architectuur

Ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidende rol binnen het team

Je werkt aan een concreet, impactvol probleem: het optimaliseren van het energieverbruik van kassen

Een inkijkje in een startup: bijbehorende financiering, subsidies, etc.

Multidisciplinaire samenwerking: met Sales, Operations en het R&D-team

ONS TEAM

Thermeleon bestaat uit een enthousiast en gevarieerd team dat is gedreven door een duurzame ideologie en een passie voor de glastuinbouw. Momenteel bevinden we ons in de startup-fase, waarbij de metingen bij de klant in een high-tech kas in volle gang zijn. Om te blijven leren (van elkaar), organiseren we elke vrijdag een 'Therming Sessie' om kennis te delen en de week af te sluiten.

We zijn onderdeel van het duurzame-startup innovatieprogramma van de Europese Unie (Climate-KIC) en ontvangen ook subsidie van het NWO-domein Toegepaste en Technische Wetenschappen (TTW) in samenwerking met de TU Delft.

WERKLOCATIE

Ons kantoor bevindt zich in de monumentale Van Nellefabriek in Rotterdam.

DIVERSITEIT

Wij streven naar diversiteit in het team! Dit geldt zowel in opleiding, achtergrond, specialisatie, en man/vrouw verdeling. Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen zich zelfverzekerd genoeg voelen om te solliciteren als ze aan 60% van de eisen voldoen, terwijl vrouwelijke kandidaten alleen solliciteren als ze elke box aantikken. Dus als deze rol bij je past maar je je nog niet helemaal zeker voelt over de criteria: we horen graag van je!

title: Intelligence Center X Engineering Manager - EMEA
description:
Build and lead the team that brings Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies across the EMEA, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases.

About Intelligence Center X

Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.

Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.

How we engage with customers

Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.


Key Responsibilities

The role

As the ICX Engineering Manager for the EMEA, you build and lead the EMEA team of ICX Engineers — a presales FDE team that leads the ideation and creation of these engagements. They model a customer's domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver working agentic applications that compel customers to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.

This is a formal people-management role, and a player-coach one. You:

  • Lead by example — build customer solutions yourself, and set the bar for how the team builds them.
  • Are a senior presence on key opportunities — with customers, and alongside sales leadership.
  • Recruit and grow the team — hire strong engineers, and develop them.
  • Evolve the global practice — work with global ICX leaders on how we engage with customers across every zone.

    • You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the EMEA Pre-Sales Leader.

    What your team's work looks like

    In a given week, one of your engineers is connecting quality and supplier data for an aerospace manufacturer to find why defects keep reaching its customers. Another is building an agentic assistant that helps a pharma company make batch release decisions in hours rather than days. You are with a third customer's leadership team, shaping the next engagement. Your job is to make sure each one lands — and that what one engineer learns, the next one starts with.


    Requirements

    Who you are

  • You lead technical teams that work with customers. Through formal management or team-lead roles, you have led customer-facing FDE, presales, services or other technical teams.
  • You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology. You still build, and your team follows your example.
  • You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined — with some of the largest companies in the world.
  • You think in business value, and you are credible with customers and sales leadership alike.

    • Skills and experience

    We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas.

  • Leading technical teams — formal management or team-lead roles for customer-facing FDE, presales, services or other technical teams.
  • Technical consulting leadership — leading client engagements and delivery teams in agentic AI, data and analytics at a consultancy or systems integrator.
  • Recruiting and developing engineers — hiring strong people, coaching them and growing their careers.
  • Senior customer presence — leading working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including executives, on key opportunities.
  • Data engineering and analytics — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.
  • Modern data and AI platforms — experience working with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.
  • Agentic AI — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.
  • Agentic development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.
  • Enterprise ontology — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.
  • Machine learning and data science — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.
  • Experience in our industries — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.

    • Travel

    Some travel is expected, up to 25%. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.


    Why Join Us
  • Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.
  • Build and lead a team. ICX Engineering is growing fast, and you shape both the Americas team and the global practice.
  • The problem every enterprise is working on. Agentic AI grounded in a company's own data and context.

title: UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware
description:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

  • Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

  • Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

  • Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

  • Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

  • You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

  • Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

  • Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

  • Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

  • Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

  • Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging

  3. Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning.

  4. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job.

  5. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

  • Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

Must have

  • Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

  • Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

Strongly preferred

Nice to have

title: Manager: Compliance Advisory (and Data Protection)
description:
About Griffin
