WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You keep Alpha's cost and schedule baselines honest against each other. Without a credible risk register and change process, changes slip into the program outside any controlled path, the IMS and cost forecast quietly drift apart, and a gate review surprises leadership with numbers nobody signed off on. Your job is to prevent that by making risk and change management a live, trusted function from the earliest stage of delivery, rather than something bolted on once problems have compounded.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Establish and maintain the Alpha risk register across infrastructure, manufacturing and machine workstreams, facilitating structured risk identification, assessment and assignment of mitigation owners

  • Own the change control process end to end, from intake and schedule, cost and technical impact assessment through to approval routing and the change log, working closely with the Cost Controller and Programme Schedule Manager so all baselines reflect the same accepted changes

  • Run regular risk reviews with workstream owners and escalate emerging risks early, before they reach senior leadership as surprises

  • Build risk and change governance standards that scale as Alpha and Stellaris grow in parallel, with different partners and delivery models

  • Support the PMO's wider reporting cadence alongside the PMO Analyst/Coordinator


WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in risk and change management on major capital programs in energy, industrial, research infrastructure or similarly complex multi-discipline settings

  • Able to build a risk and change framework from scratch, not just administer an inherited one; you know what good governance looks like before it exists

  • Confident holding the line on change discipline with internal engineers and external partners who have their own priorities, combining analytical rigor with the communication skills to make it stick

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy while program structure is still being built

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the contractor and regulatory landscape

  • Familiar with AI tools and digital ways of working, and quick to adapt in a lean, fast-paced environment

About The Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team and help drive Lokalise's growth across one of our most commercially significant segments.

The customers you'll engage span a broad range of industries across EMEA — from high-growth tech companies and digital-native brands to more established businesses undergoing meaningful transformation. once you've spoken with the team.

The role

This is a hands-on, early-career role within our Infrastructure team. Youʼll manage day-to-day

consumables purchasing, receive deliveries and keep stock records accurate, with training

and guidance from your manager and laboratory colleagues. As you learn the work, youʼll

organise your day independently and follow issues through to resolution.

Youʼll work with laboratory teams to understand demand, place orders within agreed budgets

and approvals, and chase delays before they disrupt work. Youʼll maintain supplier prices and

lead times, flag supply risks and get laboratory approval for any proposed substitutions.

At goods receipt, youʼll check orders against deliveries, including quantities, condition and

relevant batch, expiry and temperature requirements. Youʼll record receipts promptly, route

goods to the right storage and resolve discrepancies. Youʼll help physically set up storage

areas, organise stock into defined bin locations and label and barcode those locations so they

match the inventory records. Youʼll record stock movements and investigate differences

found during stock counts.

With guidance, youʼll propose reorder points and buffer stock using consumption, lead times

and planned activity. Youʼll track expiry dates, prioritise the earliest-expiring stock where

appropriate and maintain consistent item codes, units and pack conversions. Youʼll document

procedures, follow safety and quality requirements, and segregate items awaiting review.

Regular updates on supply risks and stock accuracy, together with reliable receipt records,

will help colleagues in the lab and finance.

Youʼll work directly with software engineers to shape the inventory tools you use every day.

Youʼll bring ideas from the lab, explain what needs to work differently and test new features

against real tasks. Your input will help decide what gets improved, with your manager and the

software team leading priorities, design and development. Youʼll also learn to use AI-assisted

workflows for tasks such as reviewing inventory data and preparing routine updates, then

help refine those workflows as you find better ways to work. Training and support will be part

of the role.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Learn the consumables, storage requirements and approval processes with laboratory

colleagues. Take on routine ordering and goods receipt with support.

◆ Check stock records against physical inventory and map the journey from purchase

request to use. Agree a practical storage layout and bin-location scheme with laboratory

colleagues, taking account of access and storage requirements.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run routine ordering, receipts and stock counts independently within agreed processes.

Keep colleagues informed of shortages, overdue orders and expiring stock.

◆ Physically set up and organise the agreed storage areas, label and barcode bin

locations, and link them to inventory records. Propose replenishment settings with your

manager and laboratory colleagues, and document how stock is stored and moved. Turn

recurring problems into examples for the software team.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Check that colleagues can find, receive and return stock using the labelled and

barcoded locations. Resolve gaps in the layout or records, and refine replenishment to

reduce avoidable shortages and waste.

◆ Test available inventory features against everyday tasks and help colleagues adopt

improvements. With support, try an AI-assisted workflow for a routine task, check its

outputs and suggest how to improve it.

Who you are

Youʼre proactive, organised and attentive to detail, and you enjoy practical work where

accurate records have visible consequences. When a problem arises, you flag it promptly and

investigate practical solutions while keeping colleagues informed. You act within agreed

processes, bring options when a decision needs support and follow the issue through to

resolution.

Your experience may come from inventory, purchasing, logistics or laboratory operations,

including an apprenticeship or placement. A scientific degree and coding experience are not

required. We welcome transferable experience with physical stock and time-sensitive

supplies.

Youʼre willing to help beyond a fixed task list as the team grows, while using judgement about

when to escalate. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it

and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Practical experience of inventory, purchasing, goods receipt, logistics or laboratory

operations.

◆ Careful record-keeping and an organised approach to checking deliveries, prioritising

work and following actions through.

◆ Confidence with digital tools and a willingness to learn to use AI, check its outputs and

improve recurring workflows over time. Prior AI expertise is not required.

◆ Clear communication with suppliers and colleagues, including explaining an operational

problem to a software developer.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Experience with laboratory consumables or expiry-sensitive and temperature-controlled

stock.

◆ Familiarity with inventory or ERP systems, barcode-based stock control, or testing new

software.

Why this is unusual

Alongside keeping supplies moving, youʼll help shape the software and AI-assisted workflows

that make the job easier. Youʼll work with engineers to turn a stock discrepancy or awkward

receiving step into a better tool, then see whether it works in practice. Youʼll build experience

in improving systems as well as running the day-to-day operation.

Youʼll have support as you learn, and room to contribute ideas from the start. Some people

you.

How we work

This role is primarily on-site in Kingʼs Cross, London, typically four to five days a week,

because deliveries and physical inventory need someone there. The wider team is

distributed, so we write things down and keep colleagues informed.

We start the week with an all-hands and share written updates. We give feedback directly

title: Lead Software Developer in Test
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The role

Our in-house engineering team builds and runs every product we operate. We work in two product teams, iGaming and Rewards, supported by platform and infrastructure engineers. We are partway through building a new version of our platform, which makes this the right moment to put quality engineering at the heart of how we deliver.

You will lead quality engineering across both product teams. You will guide how we test, build the frameworks and pipelines that make testing fast, and help every engineer take ownership of the quality of their own work.

This is a hands-on technical role. Early on you will write a lot of the framework code yourself. Over time your influence will come through the tooling you build and the engineers you coach.

What you'll do

  • Define our test strategy: what we test at unit, integration, contract and end-to-end level, so every team knows where a given test belongs and why.

  • Build and own our automation framework in Playwright and TypeScript, covering web front ends and APIs across both product teams.

  • Make CI feedback fast and trustworthy.

  • Bring our existing end-to-end suite to a healthy state and keep it there as the new platform grows.

  • Coach developers to write and own tests for their own code, through pairing, code review and clear examples.

  • Set up test data and environments that let teams test realistically and safely.

  • Introduce performance and load testing for our core applications.

  • Work with product managers so acceptance criteria are testable before build starts, and so testing time is part of every estimate.

  • Track a small set of quality measures, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, suite run time and flake rate, and use them to decide where to invest next.

About you

  • Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with test code written to the same standard as production code.

  • Deep experience with a modern browser automation framework. Playwright is ideal; Cypress experience transfers well (we’re in the process of migrating from Cypress to Playwright).

  • A track record of designing test strategy across the full testing pyramid for web products and APIs, including judging where automation earns its keep.

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions ideally) with Docker, and fixing pipelines that are slow or unreliable.

  • Evidence of raising quality through other people, whether by coaching developers, setting standards or leading a quality practice.

Nice to have

  • Contract testing in a service-based architecture, for example with Pact.

  • Performance and load testing with k6, Artillery or similar.

  • Using AI coding assistants to speed up writing and maintaining tests, with the judgement to review what they produce.

  • Using observability data and production signals to decide what to test.

  • Visual regression or accessibility testing.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

How you work

  • You explain quality trade-offs to product managers and business stakeholders in plain terms.

  • You will hold a release back when the evidence says it is not ready, and then help the team find a safe way to ship.

  • You write things down: strategies, decisions and guides other engineers can pick up and follow.

  • You are comfortable shaping a practice from an early stage, where you will need to decide what matters most first.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
description:
Contexte

Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingénierie@Lyon, propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux.

Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique.

Cas d’étude

Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.


Profil recherché

Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.

Type de contrat

Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois.

title: Corporate Paralegal
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Missions

As Alan’s Corporate Paralegal, you will own the corporate governance of a fast-growing international group (six jurisdictions and a dozen entities today, more in the coming months) and rebuild how that work gets done with AI. The role has three parts:

Own Alan’s corporate governance with full ownership.

  • Prepare Boards, General Meetings and committees documentation across the group, with internal teams and auditors;

  • Keep entity records, registers and filings accurate and up to date;

  • Run the annual accounts approval and filings for each entity, with Finance and auditors;

  • Be the go-to contact for shareholder and Board questions;

  • Support cross-border projects with research and drafting.

Build the governance playbook as Alan expands.

  • Set up governance for each new entity, in a way the next one can reuse;

  • Write the playbooks, templates and guidance local teams need to follow our processes;

  • Adapt equity frameworks and documentation to new countries and local rules.

Automate the repetitive work with AI.

  • Build workflows that run in the background with light human review, using no-code tools and Alan’s internal AI, with support from our tooling team;

  • Start with recurring events such as meeting minutes, equity movements and the filings calendar.

You will join the Corporate Governance Area, led by Anne-Lise Delfanne, and work alongside a team of legal and corporate operations experts. Our collaboration model encourages growth and curiosity, so you will never feel cornered in your role.

Key outcomes after six months

After six months, you will have:

  • Taken ownership of the recurring governance work for our French entities;

  • Built AI agents and workflows that take a large share of manual work off you and the team;

  • Improved our templates and documentation;

  • Reviewed or drafted legal documents in several areas;

  • Supported our international expansion, for example by opening an entity or onboarding a local team on our processes;

  • Built strong working relationships with the Corporate Governance Area, Finance, People and local advisors.

From then onwards, the role grows with you: M&A, fundraising, reorganisations and more.

Profile and competencies

Skills

This role sits at the intersection of legal knowledge, corporate operations, and AI tooling. We don't expect anyone to arrive fully skilled across all three dimensions. What matters most is your ownership mindset and genuine appetite to build. For the rest, we'll grow together.

  • Hands-on and self-starter: not scared of getting your hands dirty;

  • Automation mindset: sees repetitive work as an opportunity to build something better, not just a task to complete;

title: Projectontwikkelaar
description:
Ben jij een projectontwikkelaar met een passie voor vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling? Heb je al de nodige vlieguren gemaakt met complexe projecten en voel je je thuis in samenwerkingen met diverse partijen? Wil je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken aan uitdagende projecten, van haalbaarheid tot realisatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project.

Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties.

  • Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten.

  • Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten.

  • Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Focus op vastgoed bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer heeft grote ambities als ontwikkelaar. In onze portefeuille vind je uitdagende (gebieds)ontwikkelingen met onderscheidende concepten, veelal op binnenstedelijke locaties. Ons werkgebied beslaat Zuid-Holland, waar we de stedelijke uitdagingen omarmen en maximale waarde willen toevoegen in onze plannen. Dit resulteert in projecten waar je echt impact kunt maken op gebieden als stedenbouw, architectuur, duurzaamheid en sociale cohesie.

Als organisatie groeien we naar een vestiging waar jaarlijks 800 woningen risicodragend worden geacquireerd en verkocht. Dit betekent dat we zelf het risico dragen van de aankoop tot verkoop van de woningen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol in onze complexe ontwikkelingen.

Dura Vermeer onderscheidt zich op het gebied van samenwerking. We werken nauw samen met gemeentes, partners en stakeholders binnen onze projecten, en zeker ook met onze collega’s in Rotterdam. We staan bekend om onze intensieve en oprechte samenwerking, die leidt tot innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen in elk project.

Op nationaal niveau heeft Dura Vermeer een sterke vastgoedorganisatie waar je op kunt terugvallen. Regelmatig ontmoet je collega’s van andere vestigingen om kennis uit te wisselen en expertise te ontwikkelen. Met onze interne gebiedsstudio, ID, bieden we een expertisecentrum voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, marktadvies en verkoopmanagement, acquisitie en gebiedsontwikkeling, dat je ondersteunt bij jouw projectopgaven.

Met recent gewonnen tenders zoals Sportcampus Rotterdam, WijCK Pijnacker en De Werf in Oegstgeest en de aankoop van het Hunter Douglas terrein in Rotterdam laten we zien dat we meedraaien op het hoogste niveau van gebiedsontwikkeling.

Hier zit je op je plek

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het ontwikkelen van gebieden en buurten en het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen.

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige teams, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams.

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken!

Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk!

Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg).

Dit ga je doen

Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers.

Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en:

  • Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals  het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.).

  • Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie.

  • Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie.

  • Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart.

  • Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten.

  • Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt.

  • Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.)

Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Welke adviesopdrachten je doet, bepalen we samen met jou (afhankelijk van jouw interesses, achtergrond en kennis, en welke opdrachten er lopen).

Quote

“De variatie aan projecten, klanten en collega’s zorgt ervoor dat je snel een beeld krijgt van wat je doet als consultant. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!”

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je gaat aan de slag binnen de adviesgroep Energie en leefomgeving in het Expertisecentrum Energie & Strategie (ECES). We zijn een club jonge, enthousiaste en ambitieuze professionals die sterk gemotiveerd zijn om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je collega’s hebben bijvoorbeeld (technische) bestuurskunde gestudeerd, of bedrijfskunde, planologie, energy and environmental sciences, milieustudies, of politicologie.


Dit neem je mee

Berenschot is een verzameling van persoonlijkheden en achtergronden. We kijken dus vooral of je goed in het team past. We zoeken in elk geval een flinke dosis energie en enthousiasme, gecombineerd met nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf op inhoud en adviesvaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar net zo goed samen. Verder heb je:

  • een sterk analytisch vermogen en uitstekende sociale vaardigheden

  • sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kun je helder en gestructureerd rapporteren

  • duidelijke interesse in en affiniteit met de energietransitie en verduurzamingsvraagstukken

  • de intrinsieke drive om maatschappelijke impact te maken.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description:
As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and realize robust, manufacturable mechanical and structural solutions for the OptiArray system throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Translate product and system requirements into mechanical designs suitable for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.

  • Design and integrate structural components, interfaces, mounting features, lifting arrangements, and corrosion protection solutions into the overall product.

  • Produce engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, interface documentation, and design records.

  • Perform structural engineering analyses and testing, including lifting loads, fatigue, hydrodynamic behavior, environmental loads, and mechanical robustness.

  • Develop and evaluate prototypes and engineering models to validate structural performance and manufacturability.

  • Drive design improvements focused on manufacturability, assembly, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle performance.

  • Support product integration, verification, qualification, FAT, and industrialization activities, resolving mechanical and structural issues where required.

  • Perform engineering trade-offs considering structural integrity, weight, cost, manufacturability, corrosion resistance, offshore installation, and lifecycle performance.

  • Work closely with fabrication suppliers, offshore contractors, and technical partners to ensure designs can be successfully manufactured, deployed, and operated.

  • Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and implement effective design improvements and mitigation measures.

  • Provide technical guidance within the marine structures domain and collaborate across engineering disciplines to support sound technical decisions and successful product delivery.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times / week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, mechanical, or structural systems.

  • Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

  • Experience designing marine products, offshore equipment, or subsea mechanical systems.

  • Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.

  • Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.

  • Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred

  • Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.

  • Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.

  • Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Senior Accountmanager (new business) in Zorg & ICT
description:
Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer.

Wat je gaat doen

Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare. Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening: advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen.

Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg.

Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

  • Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op;

  • Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie;

  • Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel;

  • Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden;

  • Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen;

  • Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam;

  • Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde.


Wie jij bent

Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin?

  • Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort;

  • Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij;

  • Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego;

  • Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur;

  • Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg;

Onze harde eisen voor deze functie

  • Je bent meer een New Business Accountmanager dan een Key Acccountmanager

  • Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering;

  • Je hebt minimaal twee jaar recente ervaring met het verkopen van dienstverlening op het snijvlak van Zorg en ICT;

  • Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon;

  • Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren;

  • Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk;

  • Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

  • Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties;

  • Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt;

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen;

Over Beter Healthcare

Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt.

Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil.

Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core
description:
At Channable, we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Core Group, where you'll play a key role in integrating eCommerce channels.

You’ll be responsible for delivering maximum impact in the Core domain. You will partner up with an experienced Product Lead, with whom you will define and carry out a department vision, strategy, and roadmap. Engaged team leads and individual contributors are top of mind for you. You can learn more about the Core domain and its scope here.

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Improve and optimize processes that hamper productivity and can be more lean

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards.

This is a hands-on execution role. You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager, who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead, who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team.

What you'll be doing

Core Responsibilities

  • Assemble quantum chips into their packaging, working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB.

  • Make the electrical connections, wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering.

  • Measure and test your work, performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on.

  • Finish and close the package, including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location.

  • Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured, mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields.

  • Safeguard quality, handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip.

Supporting Responsibilities

  • Flag deviations early, stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix.

  • Help improve how we work, giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing.

  • Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace, applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready.

Your Profile

  • MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count.

  • Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems.

  • Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together.

  • Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems.

title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!

Ervaring en competenties

Persoonlijk: je gedreven en betrokken, oprecht en geeft je mening graag. Je deelt en geeft inzichten en werkt graag samen omdat het dan beter wordt. Je kan omgaan met feedback.  Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid en neemt de regie voor jouw werk

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.

At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As our GEO Manager, you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems.

You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions.

About your new role

  • GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives.

  • AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.

  • Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data (Schema.org), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences.

  • Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.

  • AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy.



Skills & Requirements

  • 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO.

  • Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content.

  • Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler).

title: Engineering Manager – Control & Low-Level Software (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we don’t just build robots, we are redefining the relationship between hardware and AI. Our end-to-end solutions seamlessly combine advanced, scalable industrial hardware with a central software suite powered by Physical AI to make manufacturing truly autonomous, efficient, and scalable. By delivering field-ready robotic solutions that just work, we empower industrial companies to automate without complexity and successfully solve the global labor shortage.

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Control & Low-Level Software (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of automation solutions.

In this key role, you will lead the team behind how our robots move: RobControl, the real-time controller running on every RobCo robot, together with control unit software, robot modeling and hardware integration. One controller codebase drives our modular robots, OEM configurations and Alfie, our autonomous industrial robot, so your team's work reaches every robot in the field. Managing a team of control, embedded and software engineers, you will balance new capabilities for Alfie and our physical AI roadmap with the reliability factory customers expect on every shift.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the hardware-software bridge: Lead the team developing our real-time controller, robot models, hardware interfacing via EtherCat, as well as core robot algorithms like motion generation and planning, calibration, etc., running on Linux-based Control Units.

  • Lead and Grow the Team: Act as a people-first leader for a mixed team of experienced engineers and early-career talent. Hire and coach, and balance roadmap work with field support through clear priorities and a fair on-call rotation.

  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Set standards for code quality, hardware-in-the-loop and automated testing, and CI/CD, so that done means tested, released and running in the field. Improve observability so field issues can be diagnosed remotely and quickly.

  • One Platform for Every Robot: Keep one controller codebase for modular robots, OEM configurations and Alfie, extending it to new kinematic structures, more joints and multi-arm systems without forking it. Manage technical debt and architectural health as we scale.

  • Partner Across Teams: Work with Product Management, Hardware, Safety & Compliance and Robot Intelligence to turn customer and autonomy needs into a clear roadmap, integrate RobControl with the safety controller, and support certification against ISO 10218 and ISO 13849.

  • Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed a university degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that ship real-time or embedded software for robots, motion systems or other industrial machines.

  • Deep experience in robot control and motion is a big plus: kinematics and dynamics, trajectory generation, and position, velocity and torque control. Strong C++ and Python on real-time Linux, with hands-on EtherCAT and ROS 2 experience.

  • Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency.

  • Expert knowledge of modern SDLC practices for software that runs on hardware, including hardware-in-the-loop testing and staged releases, with a track record of improving release frequency and field stability.

  • Working knowledge of functional safety for industrial robots (ISO 10218, ISO 13849) and experience working closely with safety and certification teams.

  • Culture-aligned mindset characterized by hardware empathy, a passion for software-defined hardware, and a strong culture of high ownership.

  • Very good English skills with the ability to navigate complex architectural discussions with Staff engineers while clearly communicating risks to stakeholders.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations.

You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works.

You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code.

What you'll do

  • Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering.

  • Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces.

  • Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first.

  • Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking.

What we're looking for

  • Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on.

  • You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team.

  • You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator.

  • You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work.

What sets you apart

  • You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside.

  • You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost.

  • You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.
