title: Research Software Engineering Intern (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend.

The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Bring the measurement software of Pre-Development together into one shared Python framework, to a target architecture your mentor defines, and migrate the existing measurement protocols onto it.

  • Keep the CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions healthy as the framework grows: tests, linting, packaging, releases.

  • Give first-pass reviews on pull requests from our engineers (tests, conventions, API conformance) before your mentor approves them.

  • Help our engineers extend the stack: new measurement protocols become modules in the framework, and you validate the migrated ones on our QDm systems together with them.

  • Document the framework and hand it over so the team runs it on its own after your internship.

 

What is expected of you

  • Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in computer science, software engineering, computational engineering, physics or electrical engineering with a strong software focus.

  • Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

  • Python is your working language: you structure packages, write type hints and tests, and have refactored or consolidated code you did not write.

  • Git and CI are routine for you, and you know how to make hardware-dependent code testable: mocked instruments, recorded data and simulation, with runs on real hardware as a separate stage.

  • AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • You review code and take review well, you can agree on a common interface with engineers who each prefer their own solution, and you treat your colleagues as your users.

  • Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Experience with instrument control or lab automation in Python, with frameworks such as qudi, QCoDeS or PyMeasure, or contributions to open-source projects are a plus, not required. What we want you to bring is the patience to read code you did not write and the discipline to leave it better structured than you found it.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

Du entwickelst gerne Software und möchtest verstehen, was Deine Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag verändern? Du hast Freude daran, Geschäftsprozesse zu durchdringen, mit Kunden Ideen zu entwickeln und diese technisch umzusetzen?

Unser Kunde, ein inhabergeführtes Softwareunternehmen mit Sitz in Villingen-Schwenningen, sucht Dich als Software Consultant – Low-Code & Business Applications (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Festanstellung.

Seit rund 15 Jahren entwickelt das Unternehmen eine eigene, cloudbasierte Low-Code-Plattform für Management-Lösungen. Über 100 Kunden weltweit nutzen das Produkt. Der modulare Aufbau ermöglicht individuelle Anwendungen, Erweiterungen und Geschäftslogiken. So werden aus Anforderungen schnell nutzbare Lösungen.

Die Nachfrage wächst. Deshalb sucht das aktuell vierköpfige Consulting-Team Verstärkung – mit technischem Verständnis, Eigeninitiative und Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kundenanforderungen verstehen: Du führst Kundenworkshops durch, analysierst die Anforderungen und dokumentierst sie als Grundlage für die Umsetzung.
  • Softwarelösungen umsetzen: Du implementierst betriebswirtschaftliche Kundenlösungen durch Customizing auf der Low-Code-Plattform und gestaltest passende Datenmodelle, Prozesse und Geschäftslogiken.
  • Kunden und Entwicklung verbinden: Du bist die technische Schnittstelle zwischen Deinen Kunden und der Core-Entwicklung und stimmst Anforderungen und Umsetzungsmöglichkeiten ab.
  • Technische Grundlagen schaffen: Du erstellst technische Spezifikationen, Aufwandsschätzungen und nachvollziehbare Dokumentationen.
  • Dein Wissen einbringen: Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei technischen Fragen und das Produktmanagement bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung der Plattform.
  • Projektverantwortung übernehmen: Je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung koordinierst und leitest Du eigenverantwortlich Projekte.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Lösungen. Deine Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum; die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt überwiegend digital. Reisen fallen nur an wenigen Tagen im Jahr an.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, gerne mit Schwerpunkt Frontend.
  • Erfahrung mit Angular und JavaScript sowie Kenntnisse in C#, .NET und SQL.
  • Eine IT-Ausbildung, ein entsprechendes Studium oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung.
  • Interesse an Datenmodellierung und daran, betriebliche Abläufe technisch abzubilden.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen im Kundengespräch zu klären und technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären.
  • Eigenmotivation, eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

In die Plattform und ihre Möglichkeiten wirst Du strukturiert eingearbeitet.

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Passende Rahmenbedingungen
  • Bis zu 85.000 € brutto Jahresgehalt, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation.
  • 40-Stunden-Woche und 30 Tage Urlaub.
  • Zusammenarbeit überwiegend vor Ort mit der Möglichkeit, einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
  • Firmenhandy auch zur privaten Nutzung.
  • Epassi und Bikeleasing.
  • Ausreichend Parkplätze und Erreichbarkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.
Technik, die Raum für Deine Ideen lässt
  • Eine eigene Low-Code-Plattform mit modularen Add-ons und integriertem KI-Chatbot.
  • Direkter Austausch mit dem Entwicklungsteam.
  • Regelmäßige Hackathons, bei denen Du neue Ansätze ausprobieren kannst.
  • Freiraum für eigene Ideen und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Offenheit für Innovation.
Ein Arbeitsumfeld zum Ankommen

title: Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer
description:

About The Exploration Company

At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.

Key responsibilities:

1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development

• Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.

• Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.

• Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).

2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment

• Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.

• Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.

• Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.

• Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.

3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management

• Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).

• Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.

• Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.

4. Validation, Testing & Documentation

• Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.

• Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.

• Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.

What we would love to see from you:

• Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.

• Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).

• Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.

• Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.

• Fluent in English.

Nice to Have:

• Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.

• Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.

• Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.

• Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).

• German and/or French.

Skills & Behaviours:

• Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.

• Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.

Why you should join us!

Our team is like a navigation system for the successful experience of our users.

  • Writing scripts for and editing driver-facing tutorial and onboarding videos that help our users get started and grow with confidence

  • Designing materials such as one-pagers, posters, and merch for our depots, often on short notice

  • Turning what you learn in support into better visual content, so our videos and materials answer the questions users actually have

You check these boxes

  • You are proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro/DaVinci/Avid and you pick up new tools quickly

  • You have a good eye for clear, engaging visual storytelling

  • You genuinely enjoy supporting users and see support shifts as a valuable part of the role

  • You welcome feedback and use it to make your work better

  • You are a team player who stays humble, reliable, and happy to take on the tasks the team needs most

  • You work in an organized, detail-oriented way and keep track of several projects at once

  • You have strong English skills; German or any additional language is a plus

It is awesome if you also have

  • Experience in scriptwriting for tutorials, explainer videos, or social content

  • Interest in support or customer-facing roles

  • An interest in user experience, onboarding, or learning design

  • Experience with Figma is a plus

Take your chance

Be a part of shaping a fast-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. Currently, we’re proceeding only with candidates authorized to work in Germany or who already hold a Job Seeker Visa.

At Bettermile, we believe delivery shouldn’t be business as usual. We’re transforming last-mile logistics to drive efficiency and create a better delivery experience for everyone.

Our geo-based, AI-powered SaaS product handles complex address processing, dynamic routing, and navigation. It is built to manage many stops and multiple constraints.

We’re setting a new standard for the last mile and pushing the industry forward, powered by a skilled, international team of tech enthusiasts, logistics experts, and a product suite designed to keep evolving.

title: Senior Sales / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:

Bei SC Ventures steigst du nicht als „Verkäufer“ ein – du übernimmst Verantwortung für messbare Umsätze und entwickelst dich zur Leitung unseres Vertriebsbereichs.

Du arbeitest im direkten Austausch mit Geschäftsführern zertifizierter Bildungsträger (AZAV) und führst sie durch unseren klar strukturierten Kauf- und Entscheidungsprozess – vom Erstgespräch bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wenn du Ergebnisse lieferst, wirst du daran beteiligt:

Du erhältst eine leistungsbasierte Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Neukunden – vertraglich geregelt, transparent und ohne politische Spielchen.

Wir reden nicht über Wachstum – wir setzen es um.

Über 50 Bildungsträger pro Jahr entscheiden sich für SC Ventures – weil wir nicht nur verkaufen, sondern liefern.

Wir selbst haben innerhalb von drei Jahren einen eigenen Bildungsträger mit über 50 Teammitgliedern aufgebaut – durch klare Vertriebs- und CRM-Strukturen. Genau dieses Fundament nutzen wir heute im Vertrieb unserer Beratung.

Jetzt suchen wir dich:

Eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die abschließen kann – und mehr will als nur closen.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst strukturierte Erst- und Beratungsgespräche mit Geschäftsführern zertifizierter Bildungsträger (AZAV) – professionell, verbindlich und mit klarem Abschlussziel.
  • Du steuerst deine eigene Sales-Pipeline – vom Erstkontakt über Follow-ups bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du präsentierst unsere Workshops und Beratungsmodelle, entwickelst Angebote und führst Interessenten konsequent durch den Entscheidungsprozess.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung und den Beratern zusammen – dein Input fließt direkt in Produktentwicklung und Vertriebsprozesse ein.
  • Bei starker Performance entwickelst du dich Richtung Teamverantwortung – bis hin zur Leitung eines eigenen Vertriebsbereichs.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B- oder B2C-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Abschlusserfolge – du hast Deals geclosed, nicht nur „Gespräche geführt“.
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf Entscheider-Ebene – du kannst mit Geschäftsführern reden und sie überzeugen.
  • Klares Sales-Mindset: verbindlich, ergebnisorientiert, fokussiert auf Conversion statt Aktivität.
  • Kommunikationsstärke & Verbindlichkeit – du kannst Vertrauen aufbauen und Deals sauber zum Abschluss bringen.
  • Bonus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, SaaS-Vertrieb oder beim Aufbau von Sales-Strukturen.

Benefits

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt
  • Umsatzbeteiligung ab dem ersten Abschluss – keine Wartezeit, du verdienst mit deinen Ergebnissen direkt mit.
  • Klarer Karrierepfad Richtung Vertriebsleitung (Head of Sales) – wer liefert, führt.
  • Feste Lead-Pipeline ab Tag 1 – du steigst nicht bei null ein, sondern arbeitest mit bestehenden Inbound-/Outbound-Kanälen.
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs (An der Alster) inkl. MacBook & iPhone.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.
  • Weiterbildungsbudget und individueller Entwicklungsplan, fokussiert auf Sales Excellence & Führung.
  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung & Zugriff auf etabliertes Vertriebs- und CRM-Framework – du musst nichts neu erfinden, du optimierst und skalierst.

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du willst gestalten, statt verwalten.
Du denkst in Lösungen, nicht in Zuständigkeiten.
Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung mit und kannst auf Augenhöhe mit Geschäftsführungen kommunizieren.

Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Wir suchen keine Mitläufer – sondern Menschen mit Drive, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Strukturen mitentwickeln wollen.
Bei SC Ventures agierst du wie ein Unternehmer im Unternehmen: mit klaren Zielen, viel Eigenverantwortung und direkter Wirkung auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden.

title: Senior Consultant Konzernkunden / Strategieberatung (m/w/d)
description:
Worum geht's?

Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert.

Und du hast gemerkt: Die Decks werden größer, die Hierarchien länger, dein Impact auf die eigentliche Entscheidung wird kleiner. Up-or-out, 60-Stunden-Wochen für die Marke eines anderen, drei Freigabeschleifen bevor du mit dem Mandanten überhaupt sprechen darfst.

Bei SC Ventures drehen wir das um: Du übernimmst eigene Mandate bei etablierten Unternehmen mit wachsender Komplexität und sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Vorstand. Keine Pyramide dazwischen. Keine drei Partner, die sich vorher abstimmen müssen.

Was du bei einer Big4/MBB-Beratung an Struktur, Methodik und Executive-Kommunikation gelernt hast, bringst du zu uns – und wirst gleichzeitig daran beteiligt, was du aufbaust: Sobald deine Bestandskunden verlängern, bekommst du eine vertraglich geregelte Umsatzbeteiligung. Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung.

Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Du gestaltest mit, wie dieser Bereich strukturiert wird, nicht nur, wie er ausgeführt wird.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

  • Du verantwortest eigenständig Beratungsmandate für Unternehmen mit wachsender Größe und Komplexität – von der Ansprache auf Geschäftsführungs-/Vorstandsebene bis zur Umsetzungssteuerung
  • Du entwickelst Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodelle für Vertriebs- und CRM-Transformation und verantwortest deren Umsetzung – nicht nur die Folie dazu
  • Du führst Strategie-Workshops und Steering-Committees auf C-Level-Niveau
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die methodische Basis für den Enterprise-Bereich mit auf: Angebotsstruktur, Delivery-Standards, Qualitätssicherung
  • Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von SC Ventures im Enterprise-Segment

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ab Senior Consultant / Berater-Level) bei einer Top-Strategieberatung (MBB, Big4-Consulting o. ä.) oder vergleichbarer Inhouse-Strategiefunktion
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen/Geschäftsführungen von Unternehmen relevanter Größenordnung
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Transformationsprojekte eigenständig zu strukturieren und zu verantworten – ohne engmaschige Freigabeprozesse
  • Executive Presence: Du überzeugst auf Augenhöhe, ohne dich hinter einer großen Marke verstecken zu müssen
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung und Beteiligung, nicht nur ein Gehalt
  • Branchenkenntnis Bildungssektor/AZAV von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – die Beratungslogik zählt mehr als die Sektor-Historie

Benefits

Was du davon hast:

  • Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Bestandskunden – vertraglich geregelt, ohne Politik
  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen
  • Schnelle Entscheidungswege – keine drei Freigabeschleifen zwischen dir und dem Mandanten
  • Kein Up-or-out – dein Wert bemisst sich an Ergebnissen, nicht an Politik oder Tenure
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Beteiligungsmodell
  • Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und klare Perspektive Richtung Partner-Modell/Teamleitung
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, MacBook & iPhone
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern statt anonymer Konzernstruktur

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du kommst aus der Top-Beratung und willst nicht mehr für die Marke eines anderen liefern. Du willst eigene Mandate, echte Beteiligung und Entscheidungen, die auch wirklich deine sind.

Wenn du lieber baust als verwaltest und lieber mit einem kleinen Team etwas Großes aufziehst, als in einem großen Team ein kleines Rädchen zu sein – dann bist du hier richtig.

title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
  • Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

title: Head of Product
description:
Head of Product (m/f/d) | Berlin | Full-Time

Location: Berlin, Germany (office first)
Start date: As soon as possible
Company: Venture-backed AI startup, early stage

About the Company

We’re a fast-growing AI company building agents for complex, high-stakes enterprise workflows in public procurement, one of Europe’s largest and least digitised markets. Our product takes on the slow, manual, document-heavy work behind public tenders. That saves businesses and the public sector a great deal of wasted time and money.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to own and scale our product function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll be the most senior product person in the company and work directly with the founders and engineering team. You’ll personally drive discovery, prioritisation and delivery. As we grow, you’ll set up how the product function works: its processes, rituals and culture. When the time is right, you’ll hire the team around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap, setting direction alongside the founders, engineering and customers.
  • Lead core product initiatives end to end, from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration. You’ll ship AI products that enterprise customers rely on.
  • Stay close to the product: test, refine and pressure-test our agents, and understand how prompts, context and evaluations shape quality.
  • Spend real time with customers. Uncover requirements, turn noisy feedback into clear priorities and become a trusted partner to their business.
  • Build the product function. Define how we discover, prioritise, ship and measure, and lay the foundations for a future product team.
  • Work with GTM on positioning and join sales conversations where product insight wins deals.


Who You Are

  • 5+ years in product management or a closely related role (founder, early operator, consulting into product), with a strong record of shipping.
  • A startup operator at heart. You’ve done your best work at early-stage companies, ideally as one of the first product hires or as a founder. Experience only at large corporates won’t be the right fit for this role.
  • A strong all-rounder, as comfortable setting strategy as writing a detailed spec, debugging an edge case or jumping on a sales call.
  • Exceptional product sense and user empathy. You look past the surface of a feature request to find the root problem.
  • Technically curious. You don’t need a CS degree or coding skills, but you’re confident working with engineers and exploring what AI can and can’t do.
  • A clear communicator who uses both qualitative and quantitative reasoning to make and explain decisions.
  • Based in Berlin or ready to relocate.
  • Fluent in English and German (required for our customer base).
  • Nice to have: B2B or enterprise software experience (strongly preferred), hands-on work with AI/LLM products, or exposure to public sector or regulated markets.


You’ll Thrive If

  • You love building from 0 to 1. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none.
  • You move fast and are energised by an intense, ambitious environment.
  • You have a “no task is too small” mindset and lead by doing.
  • You love being in the office and believe in-person collaboration drives speed.


What’s In It For You

  • Ownership from day one. You’ll define the product, with direct access to the founders and zero red tape.
  • A role that grows with you. As the company scales, so do your scope and your team.
  • Shared upside: top-of-market compensation and generous equity.
  • A mission that matters. You won’t be optimising ad clicks. You’ll be helping businesses and the public sector cut waste on a huge scale.


Our Process

  • Review: All applications reviewed within 5 days.
  • Intro call: 30 minutes on your background and motivations.
  • Product deep dive (remote): 1 hour on your product thinking and problem-solving.
  • On-site (half day): Work through a real product use case with the team, followed by 1:1s with Engineering and GTM.
  • Offer: A quick final decision and transparent feedback straight after the on-site.


How to Apply

Apply through this posting with:

  • Your CV
  • A few lines on what excites you about this role
  • Optional: links to products you’ve shipped

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 


About the role

 

As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our clients in the industry.

We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI tools are optimised for real-world operations.

This is an exciting, new role for an individual motivated to build their knowledge of AI transformation in the Energy value chain.

 
 

What you'll be doing

 

  • Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions

  • Working side-by-side with Government stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

  • Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

  • Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

  • Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

  • Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team

     

Who we're looking for

 

  • You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

  • You have some experience working on AI/data intensive projects in the Energy sector

  • You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects/products

  • You’ve worked with technical teams

  • You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

  • You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, with examples of when you’ve taken initiative and owned finding solutions to challenges

  • You’re excited and knowledgeable about the possibilities for innovation in Government technology

 
 

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Product Associate
description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're expanding access to affordable credit by launching credit products that make a real difference to customers. We move quickly, often with leading fintech, consumer and e-commerce companies, so that we can offer affordable credit at the right point in the customer journey. We work in a highly regulated environment, so our products have to work end to end from day one: technically, operationally and commercially.

 

As a Product Associate, you'll work across product, data and commercials. You'll dig into how our products perform, from funnel conversion to loan-level unit economics, and turn what you find into ideas for how we scale, improve margins and grow. You'll work hands-on with data and code, alongside Product Managers, Engineering, Credit and Operations. You'll help decide where the product goes next, as well as how we ship it.

 

This role is for top-tier STEM or Economics graduates who think like analysts, build like engineers and care about the P&L like owners, and who want to progress to Product Manager at a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech.

 

What you'll be doing

 

Product analytics & insight

  • Own analysis of product performance across the full funnel: traffic, applications, approvals, conversion, originations, repayment and credit outcomes

  • Build and maintain the dashboards, metrics and data models that Product, Credit and Operations rely on

  • Form sharp hypotheses, design experiments (journey changes, pricing, A/B tests) and measure the impact rigorously

  • Get to the root cause of anomalies quickly, whether the cause is in the data, the code or the customer journey

Unit economics & commercial thinking

  • Model the economics of each product: acquisition cost, approval and take-up rates, pricing, funding cost, expected loss, servicing cost and lifetime value

  • Put numbers on the trade-offs behind product decisions, such as wider approval versus higher losses, or partner revenue share versus volume

  • Track contribution margin and cohort profitability by product, channel and partner, and show where we make or lose money

Growth & product strategy

  • Come up with ideas for scaling and growing from where we are today (new segments, channels, products and pricing) and estimate what each one is worth

  • Look across our products and partnerships for places where they reinforce each other: cross-sell, top-ups, repeat lending, shared customers and shared data

  • Help evaluate new partner opportunities and build the business case, covering volume, economics, integration effort and risk

  • Turn the strongest ideas into clear proposals and see them through to launch

Building & shipping

  • Use AI coding tools to build and ship product end to end, across both front-end and back-end, from quick prototypes to features that go live

  • Build internal tools, automations and data workflows that remove manual work and help the team move faster

  • Be proficient with our analytics stack: build dashboards in AWS QuickSight and track funnels, events and experiments in PostHog

  • Use SQL and Python every day to pull, model and analyse data

  • Learn how our APIs, decisioning flows and data pipelines work, and work directly with engineers on specs, testing and release validation

  • Support Product Managers with discovery, delivery and partner onboarding

Launch readiness & operations

  • Define success criteria for each launch and the metrics that show whether it's working

  • Design test scenarios, including edge cases and failure modes, and test the end-to-end customer journey before release

  • Work closely with QA to make sure production releases are stable

  • Monitor production performance after release, and pick up and triage related bugs with engineering

  • Make sure new products and journeys work at launch for customer support, collections and complaints teams

  • Use operational data to spot recurring issues, fix them at the source and make sure they're closed out, not just discussed

Who you are

  • A top-tier STEM or Economics graduate (computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, economics or similar)

  • 0–2 years of experience, including internships, placements or early-career roles with real responsibility

  • Strongly analytical and confident with SQL and Python, able to go from raw data to a clear recommendation

  • Able to build with AI. You use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to ship working front-end and back-end code, and you've built things, whether side projects, hackathons, internal tools or production apps

  • Hands-on with analytics tools such as AWS QuickSight, PostHog or similar BI and product analytics platforms

  • Commercially minded. You naturally ask how something makes money, and you enjoy modelling unit economics, pricing and P&L

  • Strong product sense. You have opinions on the products you use, why they work and how they could grow

  • A structured problem-solver who can break down messy, real-world problems

  • A clear communicator who can walk an engineer through a model and make a recommendation to leadership

Nice to have: an interest in consumer credit, lending, payments or fintech; experience with experimentation and statistics.

How you work (and what we value)

  • You think like an owner, of both the customer outcome and the commercial outcome

  • You'd rather build a quick prototype or run the numbers than debate in the abstract

  • You follow through until problems are actually solved

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't wait for perfect instructions

  • You speak up when something doesn't make sense, and you help fix it

  • You put in extra effort at key moments, such as launches and live incidents, knowing that's where the real learning happens

Progression & growth

This role is a stepping stone to Product Management, with a clear progression path. As a Product Associate, you'll be expected to:

  • Build deep knowledge of our products, data and commercials

  • Consistently own problems end to end and deliver measurable business and customer impact

  • Show strong judgement, data-driven thinking and stakeholder management

High performers will progress to Junior Product Manager as they begin to:

  • Own a product area or metric independently, including its commercial performance

  • Lead defined workstreams within launches or partner integrations

  • Originate growth ideas that make it onto the roadmap and deliver results

Progression is based on impact and ownership, not time served.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company: equity

  • Hybrid working, with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days' holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month's paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together: set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Product Lead
description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The Role

We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen.

This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off.

We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you.

Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete.

The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality.

  • Lead how we quote and present offers across aggregator and price-comparison marketplaces, optimising eligibility, risk-based pricing and offer presentation to win the right customers at the point of acquisition.

  • Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book.

  • Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk we do not.

  • Work with data science to make sure our credit models are calibrated and tuned for this population rather than inherited unchanged from prime or adjacent segments, and be able to get into the data yourself when needed.

  • Use credit and commercial insight to optimise unit economics, balancing approval rates, pricing, loss rates and volume so the product scales profitably.

  • Monitor product and portfolio performance across the customer lifecycle, spotting emerging trends, risks and opportunities early.

  • Shape underwriting strategy, segmentation, credit policy and decisioning logic in partnership with risk and data science.

  • Design and evaluate experiments and strategy changes, and turn the analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Own the management information for the segment: define the metrics, monitoring and reporting that let the business make consistent decisions about the product.

  • Assess new initiatives, customer segments and product changes with both a commercial and a credit lens.

  • Present clear, structured updates on product performance to senior leadership and governance forums, and support funding and due diligence conversations where the product is in focus.

Who you are

  • A product person at heart: you care about the customer, the journey and the commercial outcome, and you want to own something end to end.

  • Quantitative and hands-on. You are comfortable in SQL and Python (or similar), you can interrogate a dataset yourself, and you can hold your own in a conversation with data scientists about model performance and calibration.

  • Credit-literate. You understand how eligibility, pricing and underwriting decisions shape the book you end up with, and you have a working understanding of adverse selection and why it matters in marketplace lending.

  • Commercially sharp, with a solid grasp of unit economics and a clear understanding that product decisions in lending have to work for both growth and portfolio performance.

  • Curious about trade-offs rather than defensive about them: alert to the fact that deeper affordability assessment can hurt conversion, and motivated by the challenge of capturing its value without sacrificing growth.

  • Able to move between detail and direction: happy getting into the data on a Tuesday and shaping the roadmap on a Wednesday.

  • Confident challenging assumptions and turning analysis into practical action, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to people who are not analysts.

  • Collaborative and credible with risk, commercial, engineering and data science teams.

  • Structured, proactive and comfortable in a scaling environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected.

Experience and background

  • Around four to five years of experience in product, credit strategy, analytics or a closely related role within consumer lending or fintech. We are deliberately targeting this level: this is a step-up role for someone ready to own a product, not a lateral move for someone who has run several.

  • Experience in unsecured consumer lending, ideally Unsecured Personal Loans (UPL), with exposure to the mechanics of acquiring customers through price-comparison or aggregator marketplaces. Direct experience in higher-APR or near-prime lending is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

  • Hands-on data skills: SQL as a minimum, and ideally Python or R for analysis. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to work alongside them as a peer and do your own analysis.

  • Experience working with or alongside credit decisioning, scorecards or risk models, and an understanding of how they are built, monitored and adjusted for a specific population.

  • Some experience of pricing, eligibility or offer design, and of using experiments or A/B tests to evaluate changes.

  • A track record of using analysis to influence decisions, not just to report on outcomes, in a role where you had some accountability for commercial results.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with Open Banking data or cashflow underwriting is a plus, as is experience in a fast-growing fintech.

What we offer:

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are hiring a Clinical Trials Lead to own the commercial work that follows. You will develop Heidi’s view of the market, identify the strongest entry point, build senior relationships across the industry, secure early customers and shape a repeatable route to market. Your knowledge of clinical trials will inform and shape what Heidi builds.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates like a founder. As the business proves itself, the role can grow into broader ownership of Heidi’s clinical trials business.

  • Develop the market thesis. Map the clinical trials ecosystem, test the most valuable opportunities and recommend where Heidi should focus its time and capital.

  • The independence to create structure, make decisions and produce results without an established playbook or a large supporting team.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.

description:
INTERNSHIP 

Agentic AI for Semi-Automating the Data Science Workflow 

Ekimetrics is the European leader in data science, with over 500 data scientists and 1,000+ projects since 2006. With offices in Paris, London, New York, and Hong Kong, we conduct projects in over 50 countries across various sectors, including financial services, retail, telecom, healthcare, and more.

Key Figures 

  • 20 years of experience in data science 

  • 500+ data scientists, all consultants 

  • 5 offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai

  • $1M+ in profit generated for our clients since 2006 

  • 1,000+ data science projects 

Within Ekimetrics, the Innovation Department works on AI research topics in collaboration with our industrial and academic partners. The department comprises several PhD experts in generative AI, deep learning, computer vision, time series, explainability, and causality. Each expert leads teams tasked with studying and building state-of-the-art methods and adapting them to specific business problems, developing new methodologies or algorithms to address identified challenges, and ensuring a seamless handover for integration within Ekimetrics' industrial ecosystem. 

A central focus of the Innovation Department is closing the gap between cutting-edge AI agents and the day-to-day reality of delivering data science at scale. The department is investing in agentic systems that accelerate the data science lifecycle while keeping data scientists firmly in control of quality, governance, and business relevance. This internship sits at the heart of that effort, combining applied AI research with production-grade engineering on Ekimetrics' modern data stack. 

Internship Objective: From a Business Question to a Trusted Recommendation 

LLM-based agents have made rapid progress in the past two years: they can now write, run and tune machine learning code with little human help. Yet real data science projects rarely start from a clean, well-defined task. They start from a business question and imperfect data, and the early choices (what to predict, how to measure success, how to validate) decide whether the result can be trusted. Automating these steps calls for assistants that know when to ask, when to stop, and how to back every claim with evidence. 

The Innovation Department is building remit, a harness that semi-automates the data science workflow. At each step of a project (framing, data design, exploratory analysis, modeling, evaluation), AI agents draft the output, automatic checks catch common mistakes such as data leakage, and a data scientist reviews and accepts the result before moving on. Ultimately, a business user brings a question and a dataset, and the system frames the problem, prepares and explores the data, compares models against a simple baseline, and returns a clear recommendation in which every figure can be traced back to the data. 

The work builds on recent research in agentic data science [1]. Agents now earn medals on many of the Kaggle competitions in MLE-bench [2], yet they tend to guess silently rather than ask when a task is ambiguous [3]. Meanwhile, tabular foundation models such as TabICLv2 [4] give strong predictive models without any tuning. 

The intern will work with senior data scientists and AI builders to build and refine remit. This internship offers an opportunity to engage with cutting-edge AI research and production engineering. 

Key Responsibilities 

The intern will: 

  • Review the latest research on agentic data science and on the evaluation of AI agents, building on the team's recent review. 

  • Design and implement remit's agents, starting with problem framing and data design, together with the automatic checks that catch mistakes such as data leakage. 

  • Help define how the system works with business users: when to ask a clarifying question, when to stop rather than guess, and how to explain results in plain language. 

  • Extend the system toward modeling and evaluation, building on trusted tools (scikit-learn, AutoML, tabular foundation models) rather than free-form generated code. 

  • Build a benchmark of realistic business cases, run experiments to measure quality, reliability and cost, and take part in a pilot with business users. 

  • Help integrate the system with the Databricks stack (Unity Catalog, MLflow) and support the safe and governed operation of the agents. 

Profile 

  • Currently in the final year of a Master's or Engineering degree, with strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, and programming. 

  • Good grasp of model validation: train/test splits, data leakage, baselines. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work autonomously on an open-ended research-and-build problem and to explain results to non-specialists. 

  • Familiarity with large language models and agentic techniques (prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, evaluation). 

  • Strong Python skills and a solid command of the standard data science toolkit (pandas/polars, scikit-learn, gradient-boosting libraries). 

  • Fluency in English. 

  • Nice to have: experience with an agent framework, solid software engineering practices (git, code review, testing), and exposure to Databricks, MLflow or cloud data platforms. 

Benefits 

  • Hands-on Research & Engineering Experience: Build a pioneering agentic system on real data science workflows, contributing to a tool with direct real-world impact. 

  • Collaborative Learning: Engage with a team of data scientists, AI experts, and PhDs in a dynamic, research-driven environment within Ekimetrics' Innovation Department. 

  • Skill Development: Gain expertise in LLM agents, the evaluation of AI systems, and production tooling on Databricks (Unity Catalog, MLflow). 

  • Career Growth: Opportunity to transition into a full-time Data Scientist role in AI at Ekimetrics, or into a PhD program, upon successful completion of the internship. 

  • Scientific Contribution: Opportunity to co-author and publish scientific papers in reputable AI and data science conferences and journals. 

  • Networking: Collaborate with Ekimetrics' industrial and academic partners, enhancing your professional network in the AI research community. 

  • Ethical and Sustainable AI: Learn to develop AI solutions that align with ethical, governed, and sustainable best practices, a core commitment of Ekimetrics. 

Duration: 6 months, Paris 

References 

[1] LLM-Based Data Science Agents: A Survey of Capabilities, Challenges, and Future Directions (2025). https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04023 

[2] MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering (2025). https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07095 

[3] Ambig-DS: A Benchmark for Task-Framing Ambiguity in Data-Science Agents (2026). https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09698 

[4] TabICLv2: A Better, Faster, Scalable, and Open Tabular Foundation Model (2026). https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11139

In large language models, a growing line of research lets the model “reason” in its latent space rather than through generated tokens, using extra depth-wise computation, reused continuous hidden states or internal iterations. This latent reasoning can improve performance without longer text outputs [1, 2]. Our hypothesis is that a similar mechanism can improve TFMs: spending more latent compute at inference on hard or ambiguous cases could help them make better use of the in-context examples. Almost all existing work on latent reasoning targets natural language, and its transfer to tabular models, whose architecture, pre-training data and output differ profoundly, remains largely unexplored. 

Mechanistic interpretability is starting to open the black box, both for latent-reasoning language models and for TFMs themselves [4]. It lets us ask not only whether latent reasoning improves a TFM, but also what the model actually computes during these extra steps, and whether that computation is faithful and useful. The internship therefore has two goals: designing and evaluating latent reasoning mechanisms for TFMs, and using interpretability methods to analyze what they learn. 

The intern will work with senior researchers and data scientists. This internship offers an opportunity to contribute to an emerging research topic at the intersection of tabular modeling, latent reasoning and interpretability. 

Key Responsibilities 

The intern will: 

  • Review the literature on latent reasoning (NLP) and tabular foundation models, building on recent surveys. 

  • Identify and adapt latent reasoning mechanisms to TFM architectures (e.g. iterative depth-wise computation, hidden-state reuse). 

  • Implement them on open-source TFMs and measure their effect on accuracy, calibration and robustness against strong baselines (gradient boosting, standard TFMs) at comparable compute. 

  • Apply interpretability methods (representation analysis, probing, activation patching) to characterize the computation performed during latent reasoning. 

  • Build an evaluation protocol on diverse tabular datasets, including realistic business cases. 

  • Document the results and contribute to scientific publications. 

Profile 

  • Currently in the final year of a Master’s or Engineering degree, with strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, and programming. 

  • Good grasp of model validation: train/test splits, data leakage, baselines. 

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work autonomously on an open-ended research problem. 

  • Knowledge of transformers and language models; familiarity with latent reasoning or recurrent-depth models is a plus. 

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, and a solid command of the standard data science toolkit (pandas/polars, scikit-learn, gradient-boosting libraries). 

  • Fluency in English is a plus. 

  • Nice to have: experience in interpretability, knowledge of TabPFN, TabICL or TabDPT, and solid software engineering practices (git, code review, testing). 

Benefits 

  • Hands-on Research & Engineering Experience: Build a pioneering agentic system on real data science workflows, contributing to a tool with direct real-world impact. 

  • Collaborative Learning: Engage with a team of data scientists, AI experts, and PhDs in a dynamic, research-driven environment within Ekimetrics' Innovation Department.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.
