At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity

 

We are looking for a Senior SRE profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.

Here are the challenges to be tackled as an SRE :

  • Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.
  • Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.
  • Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.
  • Participate in incident response.
  • Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.
  • Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)
  • Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to SRE responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. We believe SRE engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.

 

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

 

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

 

Technical stack:

  • Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL
  • Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...)
  • Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch
  • RabbitMQ: queuing system
  • Temporal.io: workflow automation platform
  • Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development)
  • Backend: Microservices written in C# ASP.NET Core 8 (running exclusively on Linux) & Golang
  • Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite...

 

Who you are

 

More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills: the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it.

We are also looking for engineers who understand the product and the customer's needs in detail and can suggest innovative ideas: in the end, it's all about delivering value to end-users.

 

In any case, you have:

  • Experience as a software engineer & DevOps / SRE
  • Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus)
  • Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus
  • Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...)
  • Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
  • A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).
  • Fluency in English

title: Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering
description:
Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering

Voor deze rol zijn wij op zoek naar een Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering die techniek, analyse en implementatie moeiteloos combineert. Jij krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen, programmeren en inbedrijfstellen van software voor gebouwbeheersystemen. Met jouw kennis van regeltechniek zorg je ervoor dat installaties juist functioneren én voldoen aan de wensen van de klant.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering kom je terecht in een fijne en professionele werkomgeving met betrokken collega’s, waar samenwerking en werkplezier vooropstaan.

Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

• Een zelfstandige en afwisselende functie waarin je softwareontwikkeling, inbedrijfstelling en klantcontact combineert;
• Werken binnen een professionele organisatie met korte communicatielijnen en een sterke focus op vakmanschap;
• Ruimte en mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied;
• Opleidingen en cursussen, volledig verzorgd door V en M Regeltechniek;
• Een werkomgeving waarin jouw technische expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je langdurige klantrelaties kunt opbouwen;
• Een prima salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring;
• 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen (bij een fulltime werkweek);
• Een goede pensioenregeling.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering bij V&M Regeltechniek ben je samen met je collega’s verantwoordelijk voor de software van onze regeltechnische systemen. Je ontwikkelt, test en implementeert programmeeroplossingen en brengt deze in bedrijf bij de klant.

Je vertaalt regeltechnische omschrijvingen naar software- en besturingsprogramma’s, test deze uitvoerig en zorgt dat ze voldoen aan de functionele eisen. Je bent betrokken bij zowel de ontwikkeling als de inbedrijfstelling en levert service, op afstand én op locatie.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het programmeren van complexe installaties en systemen;

  • Het zelfstandig inbedrijfstellen van regeltechnische installaties en gebouwbeheersystemen;

  • Serviceverlening aan klanten zowel op afstand als op locatie;

  • Het uitvoeren van functionele testen en kwaliteitscontroles;

  • Het vastleggen van jouw oplossingen en bevindingen in duidelijke documentatie;

  • Het meedenken over verbeteringen en efficiëntieverbeterende oplossingen binnen systemen.


Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent een analytische professional met technisch inzicht en een praktisch hands-on mentaliteit.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding in een technische richting;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met softwareontwikkeling en inbedrijfstelling van HVAC/regeltechnische systemen;

  • Ervaring met Priva-systemen is een pré;

  • Kennis van procesinstallaties is een pré;

  • Affiniteit met regeltechniek en automatisering;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel intern als extern;

  • Een positieve instelling en flexibiliteit om snel te kunnen schakelen.

Waar ga je het doen?

V&M Regeltechniek is een vooruitstrevend en dynamisch bedrijf binnen de gebouwautomatisering. Wij leveren slimme en innovatieve regeltechniekoplossingen voor gebouwen en technische installaties, van ontwerp en realisatie tot beheer en onderhoud. Onze projecten bevinden zich onder andere in ziekenhuizen, kantoorgebouwen, datacenters en universiteiten, waar comfort, veiligheid en energie-efficiëntie centraal staan.

Binnen V&M werken we met korte lijnen, een platte organisatiestructuur en een hands-on mentaliteit. Kantoor, werkplaats en magazijn bevinden zich op één locatie, wat zorgt voor snelle afstemming en een prettige samenwerking. Successen vieren we samen en er is volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

VDK Installatiegroep, de snelgroeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland

V&M Regeltechniek is onderdeel van de VDK Installatiegroep (110 bedrijven, 5.500 medewerkers), uitgeroepen tot Topwerkgever van Nederland. Dit betekent dat je profiteert van uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden, aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en een stabiele basis. Tegelijkertijd werk je binnen een zelfstandige organisatie waar vrijheid, ondernemerschap en betrokkenheid centraal staan. Zo verenigen we het beste van twee werelden.

Jij zorgt dat jouw team én de projecten goed draaien

Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus met natuurlijk leiderschap? Wil je niet alleen met techniek bezig zijn, maar ook een team aansturen en ervoor zorgen dat projecten succesvol worden gerealiseerd? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie functie voor je. Als Teamleider W-installaties ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en klanten. Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten soepel verlopen, dat jouw team optimaal kan werken en dat installaties volgens planning, budget en kwaliteitsnormen worden gerealiseerd. In deze rol combineer je technische kennis met leiderschap en organisatievermogen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teamleider W-installaties geef je dagelijks leiding aan een team van monteurs en technici binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek. Je bewaakt de voortgang van projecten en zorgt dat iedereen beschikt over de juiste informatie, materialen en ondersteuning.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

·        Aansturen en begeleiden van monteurs en technici;

·        Coördineren van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende projecten;

·        Bewaken van planning, kwaliteit, veiligheid en budget;

·        Overleggen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders en opdrachtgevers;

·        Zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en efficiënte uitvoering van werkzaamheden;

·        Signaleren van verbeterkansen in processen en installatietechnische oplossingen;

·        Meedenken over technische vraagstukken en innovatieve oplossingen;

·        Onderhouden van contacten met klanten, leveranciers en andere bouwpartners.


Kortom: jij zorgt ervoor dat jouw team goed kan werken en dat de projecten technisch en organisatorisch op koers blijven.

Je bent een technisch sterke professional met leiderschapskwaliteiten en overzicht. Je weet mensen te motiveren en houdt tegelijkertijd grip op planning, kwaliteit en uitvoering.

Daarnaast heb je bij voorkeur:

·        Een mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

·        Enkele jaren ervaring in de installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als eerste monteur;

·        Goede communicatieve vaardigheden;

·        Een proactieve en oplossingsgerichte houding.

Bij Campus krijg je een veelzijdige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je kunt rekenen op:

Bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld werk je binnen een technisch installatiebedrijf waar je als monteur de ruimte krijgt om zelfstandig je vak uit te oefenen. title: Teamleider Voordeur Amstelveen
description:
Ben jij een koersvaste, hands-on teamleider met een scherp oog voor de behoeften van je team en de organisatie? Heb je ervaring met administratieve processen in de zorg en weet je hoe je medewerkers en behandelaren verbindt en motiveert, ook tijdens uitdagende periodes en wanneer veel tegelijk speelt? Dan is de functie als Teammanager bij de ZorgALO iets voor jou! 


Wat ga je doen? 

Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider van het Voordeurteam binnen de afdeling Zorg ALO. De afdeling Zorg ALO (administratie, logistiek en ondersteuning) vervult een essentiële rol in de zorglogistieke en zorgadministratieve keten, van de inschrijving van cliënten tot en met de facturatie aan zorgverzekeraars. Jouw team Voordeur is het eerste aanspreekpunt van GGZ InGeest voor cliënten én verwijzers, en de spil in de verdere zorgketen. Het team verzorgt de eerste stap naar passende zorg voor zo'n 5000 cliënten per jaar, nl. de inschrijving en het eerste contact voor behandeling of opname. Tegelijkertijd verandert het werk. Digitalisering en automatisering nemen een steeds grotere plaats in. Na een herschikking van taken is het team volop in beweging om samen te bouwen aan één gezamenlijke opdracht. De dynamiek is groot en geen dag is hetzelfde. Jij zorgt daarin voor overzicht en rust. Je werkt nauw samen met zorgmanagers en de andere teams binnen de Zorg ALO. 

Je taken omvatten: 

  • Leidinggeven aan het team. Je bouwt aan een cultuur van eigenaarschap en samenwerking, waarin medewerkers zich gezien en gehoord voelen. Je voert functionerings-, ontwikkel - en verzuimgesprekken. Je creëert een open aanspreekcultuur waarin eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan.  

  • Sturing op resultaten. Je bewaakt een tijdige en passende opvolging van aanmeldingen volgens afgesproken KPI’s. Je stuurt op een soepele doorstroom van cliënten binnen het instroomproces en houdt wachttijden en toegankelijkheid scherp in de gaten. Samen met de zorgmanagers stel je prioriteiten op basis van clientbelang, anticipeer je op risico's voor instroom en capaciteit en zorg je dat vraag en aanbod op elkaar aansluiten. Over voortgang en risico’s rapporteer je helder.  

  • Samenwerking en ketenregie. Je onderhoudt contacten en werkt samen met zorgmanagers en andere ondersteunende diensten. Je neemt deel aan interne overleggen en afdelingsoverstijgende projecten.  

Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die zich herkent in de volgende eigenschappen:  

  • Je houdt het hoofd koel in een dynamische en soms hectische omgeving.  

  • Je brengt rust, overzicht en structuur.  

  • Je bent zichtbaar en toegankelijk voor medewerkers.  

  • Je spreekt mensen aan en maakt duidelijke keuzes.  

  • Je werkt doelgericht en planmatig aan resultaten.  

  • Je hebt oog voor werkdruk, welzijn en ontwikkeling van medewerkers.  

  • Je verbindt verschillende perspectieven en belangen.  

  • Je kunt schakelen tussen operationele vraagstukken en tactische onderwerpen.  

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar digitalisering, automatisering en nieuwe manieren van werken.  

  • Je krijgt energie van verbeteren en bouwen aan een team dat samen verantwoordelijkheid neemt. 

 

Waar ga je werken? 

Je komt te werken bij de Zorg ALO. Je geeft leiding aan het Voordeurteam en bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling van de instroomprocessen, waarbij je medewerkers, processen en samenwerking effectief aanstuurt om cliënten en zorgcollega’s optimaal te ondersteunen. Je krijgt de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan een Voordeurteam dat vanuit één gezamenlijke opdracht werkt: een toegankelijke, goed georganiseerde en passende start van zorg voor iedere cliënt.  

Je maakt deel uit van het managementteam van de afdeling. Je werkt daarmee niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van je eigen team, maar draagt ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van de afdeling als geheel.  

 

Ook belangrijk 

Wat vragen wij verder van jou? 

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde HBO-opleiding, je hebt ervaring met zorg- of administratieve processen met een grote automatiseringscomponent.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met dienstverlening aan professionals en cliënten, je weet prioriteiten te stellen, structuur te bieden en gericht te sturen op verbeteringen. 

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet medewerkers te motiveren en mee te nemen in veranderingen. 

  • Je doorgrondt teamprocessen snel en legt relaties met andere processen en teams. Je zoekt hierover actief afstemming met interne stakeholders. 

Wat bieden wij jou? 

  • Een jaarcontract.

  • Salaris conform CAO GGZ, FWG 55. 

  • Een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%. 

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een fietsregeling, collectieve ziektekostenverzekering en een abonnement op Cultuur Werkt. 

  • Korting op sportabonnementen via BedrijfsFitnessOnline.

Als Solution Architect ontwerp en bewaak je de ICT-architectuur van GGZ inGeest. Je zorgt dat onze informatievoorziening aansluit bij de strategische ambities van de organisatie én bij de behoeften van zorg en bedrijfsvoering.

title: Stagiair(e) Grafisch Ontwerp | AI-First | Zero Trust | Geen Brave Marketing

Die vragen beantwoorden we niet voor je. Die beantwoord je zelf, terwijl je ze leeft.

Wat ga je doen?

Je maakt visuele concepten voor ON2IT marketingmaterialen, van social media en websites tot campagnes en video. Maar je vertrekpunt is altijd AI. Je test welke tools je proces versnellen, welke je output scherper maken, en waar jouw creatieve oordeel het verschil maakt.

Je bouwt geen portfolio van mooie plaatjes. Je bouwt een nieuwe manier van werken.

Je begint elk project met de vraag hoe AI je denkproces, je output en je snelheid versterkt, en pas daarna hoe jij als creatief mens de doorslag geeft waar AI tekortschiet. Je test, je experimenteert, je bouwt werkwijzen die er vorig jaar nog niet waren.

Jij geeft ON2IT's cybersecurity positionering een frisse, scherpe uitstraling, met tools en methodes die onze sector nog niet kent.


Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je studeert grafisch ontwerp, multimedia of een verwant veld (minimaal 3e jaar).

  • Je bent actief nieuwsgierig naar AI in het ontwerpproces, kritisch en hands-on, niet bang.

  • Je combineert creatief instinct met strategisch denkvermogen.

  • Je bent proactief, leergierig en neemt eigen verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels uitstekend.

  • Je werkt goed in een team en durft te pushen.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een stageplek waar je niet bijspringt, maar meedenkt. Je werkt zij aan zij met professionals die zelf ook ontdekken hoe AI hun vak herdefinieert. Je krijgt ruimte, vertrouwen en directe feedback.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Azure (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US
 
Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  
 
At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 700 experts of 55 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  
 
Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  
 
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg, with a HQ in Berlin.
 
ABOUT THE TEAM

Help us connect Microsoft Dynamics 365 with our wider technology platform. As part of a cross-functional team, you will work with product managers, business stakeholders and engineers to turn business needs into reliable software. Your work will combine Dynamics 365 and Power Platform development with Azure services, secure APIs and event-driven integrations, taking solutions from design through deployment and operation. .

 


What your work will look like:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Dynamics 365 CRM solutions on Dataverse, including data models, plug-ins, custom APIs, model-driven Power Apps, and Power Automate flows. Choose configuration or custom code according to maintainability, performance, and business needs. 

  • Build Azure applications and integration services using C# and .NET, with services such as Azure Functions, App Service, and API Management to connect Dynamics 365 with the wider platform. 

  • Develop and consume REST APIs, Dataverse Web API and OData endpoints, and GraphQL APIs. Define clear contracts, validation, versioning, and error handling with the teams that own connected systems. 

  • Connect Dynamics 365 and Azure services to Apache Kafka through integration services and event producers and consumers. Design for retries, duplicate messages, schema evolution and reliable data synchronisation. 

  • Implement secure service-to-service access using OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, permissions and managed identities where appropriate. Protect credentials and secrets with Azure Key Vault. 

  • Build and improve CI/CD for Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure applications. Use Git and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to automate builds, tests and deployments, including solution packaging, managed solutions, environment variables and connection references. 

  • Own quality and operability through automated unit, integration and API contract tests, code reviews, monitoring and troubleshooting: document technical decisions and support releases and production incidents. 

  • Work closely with business and engineering colleagues to clarify requirements, agree acceptance criteria and deliver usable solutions in small increments. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Professional software engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse solutions in production. 

  • Strong C# and .NET skills, plus JavaScript or TypeScript for Dynamics 365 customisation. Practical experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, plug-ins, Dataverse data modelling and security roles. 

  • Experience developing and operating applications on Azure, with an understanding of cloud security, configuration, logging, monitoring and application performance. 

  • Practical experience with REST, GraphQL and OAuth 2.0, and the ability to design, implement and troubleshoot integrations across system boundaries. 

  • Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven integration, including producers and consumers, consumer groups, delivery semantics and idempotent processing. 

  • Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD, particularly application lifecycle management for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, and deploying Azure applications. 

  • Sound judgement about software architecture, data consistency and maintainability. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate across engineering and business functions. 

  • A degree in computer science, business informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

    Nice to have :

    • AI-assisted development using tools such as GitHub Copilot or coding agents to support implementation, test creation, debugging, and documentation. You review generated code critically and protect confidential data when using these tools. 

    • Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform, custom Power Apps components using PCF, or integration with Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph. 

     


What's next ?
  • Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  
  • The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 45-min Hiring Manager interview, a 60-90 min skills assessment call with the team. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.

    More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

    At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

    We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career. 

    🏡 Flexibility that works 
    Combine focused time at home with connection and collaboration in the office. Our hybrid setup includes two office days per week. 

    🚲 Your commute, your choice 
    Choose the mobility benefit that works for you: bike leasing or a Deutschlandticket.  

    🏖️ Work from anywhere in the EU 
    Change your perspective and work from another EU country for up to 15 days per year. 

    📗 Keep raising the bar 
    Use an annual learning budget of €1,000 for courses, conferences, certifications and other development opportunities that help you grow and increase your impact.  

    🫴 Support when you need it 
    Access confidential counselling whenever you need support with personal or professional matters. 

    💰 Build your future 
    Look ahead with our company pension scheme and take care of your long-term financial wellbeing. 

    Benefits may vary by location and employment setup. Your recruiter will share the details relevant to your role.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
As our Senior Technical Recruiter you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

  • Work directly with the Head of Talent day to day, with close access to the CEO, CTO, and technical heads
  • Own hiring in Germany end to end, from role definition and sourcing through to closing and signed offers
  • Turn senior leadership priorities into a capability based hiring plan and sequencing that matches delivery reality

  • Run tight pipeline management in Lever, keeping data clean, stages meaningful, and momentum high
  • Drive a fast, high signal candidate experience with clear comms, short loops, and decisive feedback

    • Who you are

  • You have experience recruiting in defence or a closely related high trust environment such as aerospace, space, advanced manufacturing, autonomy, or deep tech hardware
  • You understand the realities of secure hiring, export controls, and discretion, and you can operate professionally around sensitive programmes
  • You’ve worked in a high growth startup environment before, ideally Series A or similar, and you enjoy the pace and the lack of safety rails
  • You treat recruiting as a strategic function, not an admin service, and you’re comfortable challenging briefs and sharpening the bar
  • You can take a messy need and turn it into a crisp role, clear success outcomes with scorecards
  • You can proactively source top tier talent and build pipelines, not just manage inbound applicants

    • What we offer

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

title: Publishing Product Director
description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation

  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).

  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

What you will own

  • People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

  • Engineering ways of working: code review standards, quality gates before release, build and release pipeline, and a deliberate plan to reduce hotfixes and technical debt.

  • Architecture and platform: owning the technical foundations shared across our games, including our in house SDK, analytics tracking, live configuration and the setup of A/B tests.

  • Delivery partnership: working with the producers who lead our cross functional game teams on estimates, capacity and technical risk, and having the final say on whether a release is technically ready to ship.

  • Transparency: making engineering progress, quality and capacity visible to the rest of the company through clear, measurable indicators.

What you bring

  • At least four years managing an engineering team of five or more people, including performance management and hiring.

  • A strong engineering background of your own, ideally in C#, Unity or mobile development, so you can lead architecture and review decisions with credibility.

  • A proven track record of success in a commercially driven company operating live products with real users, where engineering decisions are made against business priorities.

  • A track record of raising quality and delivery predictability in a small or fast moving company, with concrete examples of what you changed and how you measured it.

  • Comfort with direct conversations and with holding people to clear standards: Open, respectful, goal orientated.

  • A pragmatic, data driven approach: you decide based on what the numbers show, and you introduce the process only where it pays back.

Strong plus

  • Experience in frequent shipping of mobile games, ideally free to play, casual or hybrid casual titles.

  • Hands on knowledge of ad monetisation and mediation SDKs, mobile measurement partners and A/B testing infrastructure.

  • Experience introducing CI/CD, automated testing or release quality gates in a game studio.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to Sunday: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

If you want to build the future of digital companionship, Sunday is your home. Apply now!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
description:
Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own

  • AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

  • Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
YGO.ai is a VC-funded AI tourism platform. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our cloud platform, the APIs our enterprise clients run on and the company itself.


🛡️ About this role. The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.

The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.

We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

  • Application security. Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

  • Detection and response. Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

  • Cloud and platform hardening. Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

  • The security of our APIs. Authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, token scoping and lifecycle, abuse prevention, enterprise SSO and the audit trail our clients and our own accountability depend on

  • The security of our AI systems. Prompt injection, tool and agent permissions, our MCP server, retrieval and data ingestion. The data-residency rules we are held to contractually

  • Identity and company security. SSO, MFA and privileged access for employees, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MDM, endpoint security and SaaS access. The practical IT security a company our size needs done, not discussed

  • Secure design across the pods. Threat modelling and design review that enables engineers rather than gatekeeping them and raises the standard of what they ship

  • The security function itself. Set the priorities and the roadmap from actual risk, not security theatre. Decide what we build, buy, automate or leave for later. Grow the team and hire into it, represent security to enterprise clients and carry our SOC 2 programme on Drata. Compliance is part of the job and it is not the centre of it

🚢 What you'll secure

  • An AI search and recommendation engine for major travel enterprises: enterprise integration, SSO, client security reviews, GDS integrations

  • A content enrichment API sold as SaaS: high scale, public facing, data and AI heavy

  • The platform underneath: a client console with organisations, projects and API tokens, supplier and business-client integrations, data ingestion, an MCP server, and several LLM providers behind a single internal library

📚 Our stack

  • Backend: Go monorepo (no framework, 3+ services)

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Redis Asynq queue

  • Hosting: PaaS-managed containers, Cloudflare in front

  • Observability: Jaeger tracing, BetterStack for logging, alerting and on-call

  • Compliance: Drata, SOC 2 in progress

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, used across the whole team

✅ You must have

  • 5+ years of hands-on security work spanning more than one discipline. Not five years of engineering with some security in it. This role sets the standard for the company, so it needs someone who has seen enough to have judgement rather than opinions

  • Application security depth. You know how modern web applications and APIs are attacked. You can validate an issue yourself through code review or a targeted penetration test and work with the engineer on the fix

  • A strong grasp of authentication and authorization. OAuth and OIDC, sessions, token handling, access control and the failure modes behind most API breaches

  • Cloud security fundamentals, properly. Identity, network, workload and pipeline security on a modern cloud platform, applied to production systems you were responsible for

  • Defensive experience alongside the offensive. You have investigated real incidents. You have built or improved the detection and alerting that catches them

  • Threat modelling and secure architecture for cloud, container and API systems

  • An engineering background. You are comfortable in a codebase, you can review what our engineers and our AI tools produce and you can build what you need yourself. Our backend is Go. Prior Go experience is a plus and not a requirement

  • Comfort in resource-constrained environments. Startups, small security teams or consultancies taught you to prioritize on risk, business impact and available resources and to execute yourself

  • The appetite to build a team. You want to grow this function and eventually lead it. Prior leadership experience is a plus and not a requirement. We would rather have depth and develop the leadership than the reverse

  • Working proficiency with Claude Code. Share specific examples

  • Judgement about pace. You secure a company that ships daily without becoming the reason it stops. Guardrails over gates

  • Experience of SOC 2, ISO 27001 or demanding enterprise security reviews

  • Excellent spoken and written English. You will talk to auditors, client security teams and our own engineers, often in the same week

  • ⚠️ European or African time zones (±3 hours from CET)

  • Available full-time (40 hours per week)

🌟 Nice to have

  • AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, model security, retrieval pipelines. Very few security roles let you both use AI as your main tool and secure it as your subject. This one does

  • Early security hire experience. You have been the first or one of the first security hires at a startup or scale-up

  • Experience leading or mentoring security engineers

  • Go

  • Security tooling or automation you built yourself

  • MDM, endpoint protection and identity provider administration (Google Workspace or similar)

  • Compliance automation tooling (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe or similar)

  • Security certifications. Valued as a signal, never required

  • GDPR depth. Travel or GDS exposure

  • German

❤️ You are a great fit if you

  • See security as an engineering discipline. You ship fixes and guardrails, not slide decks

  • Can explain a vulnerability to an engineer and its business risk to a client's security lead in the same afternoon

  • Have done offensive work as a penetration tester or consultant and wanted broader ownership than producing reports

  • Want to build something and own it, rather than advise on someone else's

  • Are comfortable challenging unnecessary security bureaucracy and genuinely risky engineering decisions alike

  • Get frustrated when a security fix takes weeks instead of days

Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” (The Real-World Learning Loop, Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

Responsibilities

  • Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments.

  • Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop.

  • Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next.

  • Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot.

  • Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard.

  • Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm.

  • Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join.

  • Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation.

  • Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML.

  • Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships.

  • Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction.

Not in scope, by design

  • Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next.

  • A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer.

  • Product roadmap and pricing.

What makes this role hard

  • Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open.

  • Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system.

  • A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses.

  • By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet.

  • By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning.

What you bring

  • You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it.

  • Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first.

  • Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join.

  • You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work.

  • You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it.

  • PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record.

Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first?

  2. If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop?

  3. How do you decide what to publish and what to keep?

What we offer

  • Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them.

  • A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity.

  • Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in.

  • Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support.

How we hire

Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast.

description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Reporting to the CISO, you'll own the security roadmap for Pigment's product, infrastructure, and CI/CD environment, and you'll build much of it yourself.

This is a hands-on role: expect to read code, threat model new services, reproduce and triage vulnerabilities, dig through infrastructure configuration and build the automation that closes gaps.

You'll also set direction and bring product and engineering with you, but that influence comes from technical credibility and not process: the engineers you work with will take you seriously because you've been in the same code they have.

The scope is broad: application security, infrastructure security, detection and response, and the assurance work that keeps our certifications standing. You won't be covering it alone. The security team is seven people and growing, with colleagues already owning compliance, governance and security operations, so this role can go deep on product and infrastructure and not be spread too thin across everything. Nobody arrives fluent in all of it: we're looking for real depth in several of these areas and the judgement to grow into the rest.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Product & Infrastructure Security Design - Design security features into the product itself and strengthen defence-in-depth across the platform. Threat model new services before they ship, and make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse later.

  • Security Review & Risk Assessment - Review code, architecture and configuration yourself, and be the person developers and PMs bring problems to early rather than late. Deliver solutions that balance risk against business benefit, and escalate the calls that genuinely need senior arbitration.

  • Assurance & Testing - Run our assurance programme: internal code, architecture and configuration reviews, red team exercises, and the bug bounty. Own the relationship with third-party auditors, and measure the control KPIs that keep our certifications defensible.

  • Vulnerability Management - Own vulnerabilities from detection through to verified fix: reproduce them, score and triage them, design or validate the mitigation, and confirm it actually worked. Improve the KPIs that tell you whether the process is holding.

  • Detection Engineering - Build and improve our detection capability alongside the infrastructure and engineering teams: identify the signals worth collecting, write rules that catch real attacks without drowning us in noise, and build the response playbooks behind them.

  • Incident Response - Lead security investigations into the production environment end to end, from first signal to root cause, across incidents and fraud. Flag the repetitive work worth automating and the detections worth building, and hand those to the security operations team.

  • SDLC - Set the technical direction for how engineers at Pigment build securely: guidance, paved paths, and reviews that teach and not just gate. Contribute to company-wide awareness where it counts, but your primary audience is product, engineering and SRE.

 

Example projects that would fall under your responsibilities (actual examples of recently completed or currently on the roadmap):

  • Secure the design and development of our AI features, including the MCP Server and Modeler Agent: threat modelling, design reviews, working alongside the engineers building them, and security assessments. 

  • Work out where AI-assisted analysis actually belongs in our pipeline. AI-powered security reviews reason about a diff semantically rather than pattern-matching it, which is genuinely different from classic SAST - but it's not a drop-in replacement, and figuring out the split between AI review, traditional SAST and SCA is an open question we'd like you to answer with evidence rather than vendor claims.

  • Migrate GitHub to managed identities: provisioning through Okta, retiring personal accounts and long-lived PATs, and moving CI to short-lived OIDC credentials instead of stored keys.

  • Design agent identity for the MCP Server - delegated access tokens, token exchange, and making sure an agent acting for a user can never exceed what that user could do themselves.

  • Push least privilege further across production and CI/CD. Better than it was, not where we want it.

For a concrete example: here's how we built a sandboxed execution environment for LLM-generated code.

Technical Environment

Mostly production, with the occasional internal IT-adjacent project: 

  • Main sites in Paris, London, Toronto and NYC 

  • MacOS, Windows, Linux workstations

  • GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Postgres, SingleStore, Vault

  • Okta, OAuth, JWT, C#, .NET Core, TypeScript, React, Python, Go

  • Datadog (SIEM), CloudFlare ZTNA, Falco, Wiz, Riot, HackerOne, TruffleHog

  • Google Workspace, Jumpcloud, Vanta, Hibob, Slack

  • GitHub, CircleCI, ArgoCD

  • SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 42001

Who you are

You have at least 8 years of experience in security as a Security Engineer, Pentester or Security consultant, with real depth in product and/or infrastructure security. We care more about the scope of what you've owned than the exact number of years.

What you've done

  • Owned a security roadmap for a product or platform end to end, rather than delivering items on someone else's

  • Driven security work through engineering teams you had no authority over

  • Been the person your organisation escalated to on hard architectural calls

  • Worked hands-on across a broad technical surface - development, databases, networking, web

How you work

  • You're hands-on and intend to stay that way (this position does not include people management)

  • You look for the workable answer, not the blocking one

  • You have a good dose of humility, and you help the people around you get better

  • You speak English fluently, French is a strong plus


How we hire

After a first call with our recruiter, five conversations, around four hours in total, usually over two to three weeks:

  1. Ways of working (45 min) — how you operate with people, and what draws you to this role specifically.

  2. Technical deep dive (1h30) with a security engineer — including a practical. We'll give you a real problem we've already solved and talk through how you'd approach it.

  3. Cross-functional (45 min) with an engineer from product or platform — someone who'd be on the receiving end of your work.

  4. Ownership and career (1h) with the CISO and a member of the security team.

  5. Final (45 min) with our co-founder and CTO.

You will design, build, and continuously improve the AI-powered systems that help Dust support customers with speed and quality. This includes agents for ticket classification, auto-acknowledgement, response drafting, internal routing, proactive incident detection, knowledge retrieval, and escalation support.

You will identify categories of recurring issues and engineer them out of the support queue. Sometimes that means building a better Dust agent. Sometimes it means improving documentation, creating an internal tool, tightening a workflow, writing a script, or escalating product feedback upstream with enough context for engineering to act.

You will be expected to measure whether the systems you build actually improve the user experience. Seniority here means not just shipping tooling, but knowing what good looks like, instrumenting it, and iterating until the impact is visible.

Running complex support when the systems fall short

You will still be close to the work. You will investigate complex customer issues across logs, code, internal tooling, product behavior, and agent outputs. You will provide clear, accurate answers to customers, including when the underlying issue is ambiguous or technically complex.

You will handle escalated cases with precision and judgment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical users. You should be comfortable translating between customer language, product behavior, engineering detail, and business impact.

When AI-generated responses are incomplete, inconsistent, or wrong, you will debug the system behind them. You will improve prompts, knowledge sources, workflows, routing, tooling, and escalation paths so that the same failure mode does not repeat.

Shaping the support strategy

You will help define how Dust should run support as we scale. That means thinking beyond the queue and owning the full loop: what customers experience, what support sees, what agents can handle, what engineering needs to fix, and what product should learn.

You will translate repeated customer pain into high-quality product signal. You will build strong working relationships with engineers and product teams so escalations are high-context, actionable, and efficient.

You will also help raise the bar for how the support function operates: what we measure, how we prioritize, how we review quality, how we onboard junior team members, and how we decide what should be automated versus handled by a human.

What we are looking for

Every candidate and employee’s success at Dust is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude, and Agency.

Aptitude

You have strong technical depth. You are comfortable with APIs, web applications, logs, scripts, and internal tools. You can navigate a codebase, reason through product behavior, and troubleshoot systems without being stopped by a stack trace.

You have genuine AI fluency at builder level. You have built agents, automations, workflows, or internal tools using AI systems such as Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, GPT-4, Claude, Mistral, Gemini, or similar platforms. You are not just good at prompting. You understand how to turn AI into operational leverage.

You have experience operating at the strategy layer of support, not only at the ticket layer. You have owned or helped shape support systems, support tooling, escalation workflows, deflection strategy, knowledge management, or AI support operations.

You can balance technical accuracy with user experience. You care about whether the customer understood the answer, whether the product pain was addressed, and whether the issue will happen again.

You are able to communicate bidirectionally: clearly enough for customers, technically enough for engineers, and strategically enough for leadership.

Attitude

You combine resilience with empathy. This is a front-line role, and customer frustration is often direct and unfiltered. You do not take it personally, but you do take it seriously.

You are proactive rather than reactive. You do not wait for a perfect problem statement from the customer. You investigate, infer, clarify, and anticipate what they may need next.

You have strong prioritization judgment. You know what needs an immediate human response, what can be automated, what should be escalated, and what should become product feedback.

You are comfortable setting boundaries. You do not say yes to everything, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly in a way that builds trust rather than eroding it.

You care about the craft of support. You see support as a product experience, not a back-office function.

Agency

You turn patterns into systems. When you see the same issue twice, you start asking whether it should exist at all.

You go deep before escalating. You investigate as far as you reasonably can, so that when you involve engineering or product, they receive a clear problem statement, relevant evidence, and a useful recommendation.

You build without waiting for permission. If you see a gap in the support system, you are excited to prototype, test, and ship a better version.

You continuously improve your own workflows. You treat your time, your tools, and your operating system as things worth debugging.

You extract product opportunities from customer interactions. You do not let support signal disappear into a solved ticket. You close the loop.

What strong candidates may have done before

You may have:

  • Built or led an AI-powered support function

  • Designed support agents, internal copilots, escalation workflows, or deflection systems

  • Owned technical support tooling, support operations, or automation at a fast-growing software company

  • Worked as a senior support engineer, technical support engineer, developer support engineer, support ops engineer, solutions engineer, or implementation engineer

  • Built a support product, internal platform, AI startup, or automation-heavy support system

  • Operated in a high-volume environment where quality, speed, and judgment all mattered

We care more about the depth and relevance of your experience than the exact number of years. That said, we expect this role to be a fit for someone who has already spent several years close to technical support, support engineering, AI tooling, or support systems ownership.

What this role is not

This is not a traditional customer support role focused only on ticket resolution.

It is not a people-management role where you are far away from the technical work.

It is not a pure operations role where you optimize process without building.

It is not a role for someone who is curious about AI but has not yet built with it.

The person we are looking for should be excited to own the messy middle between customers, AI agents, internal tooling, engineering, and product.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Substantial relocation support, up to 10k€, including help finding an apartment in Paris and support with the visa process

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, and equipment

  • Beautiful office in the heart of Paris

  • Opportunity to travel to the US multiple times a year

  • Regular team events and offsites

We can go higher for exceptional profiles.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

description:

  • Superviser les étapes de post-production et de retouche, en garantissant le respect des standards de qualité attendus
  • Être garant(e) du rendu visuel, de la cohérence et de la qualité des images diffusées sur le site

  • Maîtrise de l’organisation et du pilotage de shootings photo à forts volumes

  • Aptitude à résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles et à garantir le respect des engagements de livraison
 
 
Qualités personnelles

  • Sensibilité visuelle et exigence en matière de qualité
  • Leadership et capacité à fédérer des équipes
  • Réactivité et aptitude à gérer des environnements de production exigeants
