ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

IMT Mines Albi, au travers du Centre Génie Industriel (CGI), développe des recherches à la frontière entre l’intelligence artificielle et le génie industriel, en collaboration avec des partenaires publics et industriels nationaux et internationaux.

Le Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) (https://cgi.imt-mines-albi.fr/) compte environ 70 personnes dont 25 doctorants. Le centre s’intéresse à l’accompagnement de la transition des écosystèmes en permettant de prendre des décisions responsables et durables, dans des environnements instables ou perturbés. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés.

Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont :

  • Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS dans lequel ce poste est rattaché.

  • Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ;

  • Axe TRACE : Territorial Resilience, Agility, and Circular Economy ;

  • Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services.

Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont :

  • HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ; 

  • AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Dans le contexte de l’Education 4.0, les différents acteurs d’un établissement de formation universitaire (étudiants, personnels, intervenants extérieurs, etc.) ont des contraintes et des objectifs différents ce qui rend complexe la coordination et le pilotage de tels établissements (organisation et planification des enseignements, gestion des espaces collectifs, organisation des sessions d’examens…).

En complément, ces établissements doivent s’adapter tant sur la gestion de leurs sites (meilleure adéquation à de nouvelles formes pédagogiques) que sur les flux de personnes les utilisant pour une meilleure répartition des charges et une interopérabilité de tous les outils à disposition (par exemple, un gestionnaire d’emploi du temps). Dans ce cadre, le jumeau numérique organisationnel représente le système qui permet une simulation et une aide à la prise de décision par des échanges bidirectionnels entre l’organisation physique (personnes et systèmes dont les bâtiments) et sa réplique virtuelle dans un objectif de pilotage global des flux.

Le projet DIGIFAC’Santé s’inscrit dans ce contexte. Il porte sur la conception et le développement d'un jumeau numérique des sites d’une université, de la gestion des flux étudiants et personnels et de l’évolution pédagogique de ses formations.

Un jumeau numérique ne peut remplir son rôle qu'à la condition de représenter fidèlement les informations essentielles à la prise de décision, elles-mêmes issues de données collectées dans les différents services de l’Université et des applications logicielles actuelles. Or, ces applications présentent des niveaux d’hétérogénéité différents selon leurs fonctionnalités. La nature des opérations réalisées (emploi du temps, gestion des salles et du matériel, etc.) impose des contraintes fortes sur la disponibilité de ces données : leur collecte automatique et en temps réel n'est pas toujours techniquement envisageable, ce qui constitue un défi central pour l'alimentation du jumeau numérique.

L’étude à mener dans le cadre de ce projet vise à :

Modéliser le besoin informationnel. Il s'agit de concevoir un méta-modèle capable de représenter, de façon générique et formelle, les informations strictement nécessaires à l’alimentation du jumeau numérique universitaire. Ce méta-modèle doit permettre de cadrer la remontée d'information en définissant le juste besoin, c'est-à-dire en distinguant ce qui relève de l'information décisionnelle de ce qui constitue un artefact de collecte sans valeur ajoutée pour le pilotage.

Alimenter les modèles. Une fois le méta-modèle du besoin informationnel établi, la question de son instanciation à partir de données réelles des applications existantes se pose. Comment alimenter ces modèles à partir de données hétérogènes, partielles, et produites selon des rythmes et des modalités de collecte variables ? Ceci articule des enjeux d'intégration, de qualité et de cohérence de la donnée au regard des exigences du jumeau numérique.

Gérer l'absence de certaines données. Dans un contexte où certaines opérations ne permettent pas une collecte automatique et en temps réel, en raison de la nature même des processus mis en place (par exemple, construction de l’emploi du temps, suivi des cohortes d’étudiants), comment maintenir la cohérence et la complétude de la représentation portée par le jumeau numérique ? Ce lot interroge la capacité du système à pallier les lacunes de la remontée de données par des mécanismes d'inférence ou de déduction, permettant de reconstituer un état vraisemblable du système à partir d'informations partielles.

Proposer des aides au dimensionnement et au pilotage des sites universitaires. Il s’agit ici d’utiliser le jumeau numérique dans toutes ses fonctionnalités afin entres autres de s’assurer que les évolutions bâtimentaires envisagées permettent d’accueillir l’ensemble des flux actuel et projeté pour cet établissement, de permettre d’optimiser les flux entre les différents sites et de valider les choix d’évolution des pratiques pédagogiques et leur adéquation vis à vis des capacités disponibles (salles et équipements spécifiques, surfaces, personnels,etc.).

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

  • Modélisation des processus / d’organisation

  • Analyse systémique

  • Analyse de données

  • Ingénierie dirigée par les modèles

  • Aide à la décision

  • Simulation à évènements discrets et jumeau numérique

  • Fouille de processus (process mining),

  • Des connaissances en algorithmique, UML, Web sémantique seront très appréciées

Capacités et aptitudes :

  • Anglais écrit et parlé (Niveau B2 minimum exigé) ; cf. référentiel européen ; ex. :  785/990 minimum au TOEIC), attesté par une certification reconnue (TOEFL, TOEIC, IELTS).

  • La maîtrise du français (C1 minimum) est exigée afin de faciliter les échanges avec les experts et les acteurs.

  • Capacité à travailler dans une équipe de recherche, autonomie, esprit d’initiative, organisation, curiosité intellectuelle…

  • Motivation pour contribuer à une application universitaire

Ingénieur.e recherche ou post-doctorant, en génie industriel et/ou supply chain management et/ou Génie Logiciel ou Master ou équivalent (niveau Bac+5).

title: Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.


  • A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus).

  • Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data.

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus.

  • An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume.

  • Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations.

  • 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply.

  • A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling

  • Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes

  • Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation

  • Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs

Who you'll work with

You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast.

What's in it for you?

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

That’s where you come in.

title: Stagiair Finance
description:

En die administratie is bij Claus behoorlijk veelzijdig. Binnen onze organisatie komen horeca, events en leisure samen. Je wordt begeleid door onze Finance-collega's en krijgt gedurende je stage steeds meer ruimte om werkzaamheden zelfstandig op te pakken. Natuurlijk houden we daarbij rekening met jouw opleiding, leerdoelen en wat je vanuit school moet aantonen.

Dit is Claus Group

Claus Group is een veelzijdige horecagroep waar gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en beleving centraal staan. Vanuit onze locaties in Hoofddorp en Amsterdam creëren wij elke dag opnieuw bijzondere ervaringen voor onze gasten.

Claus Group bestaat uit verschillende unieke hospitalitymerken. Bij Claus Events organiseren wij jaarlijks honderden congressen, vergaderingen, bedrijfsfeesten en andere zakelijke evenementen. Met 20 moderne bowlingbanen en het sfeervolle American 50’s Diner restaurant biedt Claus Bowling gasten een gezellige middag of avond uit. Elk merk heeft zijn eigen karakter, maar samen vormen we met ruim 150 collega’s één familie. We staan voor elkaar klaar en doen er alles aan om de verwachtingen van onze gasten te overtreffen. Dat doen we met passie, vakmanschap en plezier. We geloven in korte lijnen, samenwerken, ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke aandacht. Of je nu werkt in de bediening, keuken, techniek, evenementen of op kantoor: iedere collega draagt bij aan de beleving van onze gasten. Jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil!

Bij Claus Group werk je niet zomaar in de horeca. Je werkt in een organisatie waar iedere dag iets anders gebeurt, waar collega's voor elkaar klaarstaan en waar je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens je stage draai je mee met de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze Finance-afdeling. We beginnen natuurlijk met een goede uitleg en begeleiding. Naarmate je meer leert, kun je steeds meer werkzaamheden zelfstandig uitvoeren.

· Inkoopfacturen verwerken en controleren;

· Meewerken aan de crediteurenadministratie;

· Bankmutaties verwerken en controleren;

· Ondersteunen bij de debiteurenadministratie;

· Openstaande posten controleren en opvolgen;

· Betalingen en financiële gegevens controleren;

· Verschillen en afwijkingen helpen uitzoeken;

· Financiële documenten verwerken en archiveren;

· Contact hebben met collega's over ontbrekende of onduidelijke informatie;

· Ondersteunen bij periodieke controles en afsluitingen;

· Werken met Excel en onze financiële systemen;

· Gegevens verzamelen en controleren voor financiële overzichten;

· Meedenken over hoe administratieve processen slimmer of efficiënter kunnen;

· Ondersteunen bij andere financiële werkzaamheden die binnen het team voorbij komen.

Welke werkzaamheden je precies oppakt, hangt ook af van jouw opleiding, ervaring en ontwikkeling tijdens de stage.

Wat ga je bij ons leren?

Een stage is er om te leren. We vinden het daarom belangrijk dat je niet alleen taken uitvoert, maar ook begrijpt waarom je iets doet.

Tijdens je stage leer je bijvoorbeeld hoe een financiële administratie binnen een organisatie wordt opgebouwd en bijgehouden, hoe verschillende geldstromen worden verwerkt en waarom een correcte administratie zo belangrijk is voor de rest van de organisatie.

Je leert afwijkingen herkennen, verbanden leggen en steeds kritischer naar cijfers kijken. Want als een bedrag niet klopt, is het uiteindelijk veel interessanter om te ontdekken waarom het niet klopt dan het alleen te corrigeren.

Daarnaast krijg je een goed beeld van de samenwerking tussen Finance en andere afdelingen binnen een organisatie.

Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen ervaren financieel medewerker te zijn – daarvoor loop je juist stage. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent en graag wilt leren.

  • vindt het leuk om met cijfers te werken;

  • beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en kunt je ook in het Engels redden.

Ervaring met financiële software of Exact is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een stage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het Marketingteam en verschillende kanten van het vak kunt ontdekken.

At Ockto, our mission is to set the benchmark for simple, secure, and ethical personal data sharing. Already a vital part of digital journeys like mortgage applications, rental agreements, and private lease processes, we enable people to control and share their sensitive data with confidence.

As our platform grows, reliability, scalability and security become increasingly important. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you help build and operate the platform that keeps Ockto available, secure and performant across millions of transactions — and you keep it that way as we scale into new markets.

We are a team of curious, highly skilled engineers who value ownership, trust and continuous improvement. You’ll have the freedom to make a real impact while working in a collaborative environment with short decision-making lines.

The Opportunity: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

We are growing rapidly and pushing boundaries in secure, cloud-native digital services. We’re seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who thrives on impact and innovation. You’ll be part of a collaborative and diverse team, contributing directly to our SaaS platform built with TypeScript and .NET technologies in a public cloud environment.

At Ockto, you’ll find:

  • A dynamic, ambitious engineering culture that values trust, autonomy, and ownership.

  • A team of smart, friendly colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other to grow.

  • A product with real societal value-empowering users to take control of their personal data securely and effortlessly.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work across engineering to continuously improve the reliability, resilience and security of the Ockto platform.

  • Design, build and automate secure, scalable AWS infrastructure and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.

  • Drive reliability and resilience through observability (monitoring, logging, alerting), incident response, root cause analysis, and disaster recovery / business continuity.

  • Strengthen our cloud security posture and operate the controls behind our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments — IAM, secrets management, hardening, and native tooling such as GuardDuty, Security Hub and CloudTrail.

  • Keep cloud cost efficient, balancing performance and resilience against spend.

  • Drive structured adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (code assistants, automated testing, spec-to-code pipelines).

  • Uphold privacy and ethical standards, recognising the responsibility that comes with managing people’s most personal data.

About the Ockto Platform

The Ockto platform enables consumers to securely collect and share personal data: such as identity, income, assets, and spending from trusted sources like government agencies and financial institutions.

Trusted by many organisations and financial service providers, Ockto replaces outdated manual data sharing with a streamlined, digital-first experience that benefits both consumers and businesses.

With Ockto, users are in control. No paperwork, no emails, just secure, verified data sharing at the click of a button.


About yourself

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or DevOps.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK or CloudFormation).

  • Experience with Linux, networking and cloud-native architectures.

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring and observability.

  • Experience securing cloud platforms using IAM, secrets management and infrastructure hardening.

  • Experience with scripting or programming (Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell).

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • A passion for automation, reliability and continuous improvement.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with AWS security tooling (Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector or CloudTrail).

  • Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or other security frameworks.

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated environment.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted tooling responsibly in a regulated or data-sensitive environment (data-leakage awareness, prompt and secrets hygiene).

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge).

  • Experience with Docker.

  • Familiarity with operational-resilience requirements such as DORA.

What you get

We offer an inspirational international working environment where:

  • You’ll be working on in-depth engineering challenges with high-tech solutions.

  • You can grow and broaden your professional skills.

  • We respect a good work/life balance.

  • We have an eye for your unique person & talents and allow you to apply them.

Also, Ockto will provide:

  • A good salary;

  • Room and budget for investing in your personal and professional development;

  • A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice;

  • Phone- and travel-allowance;

  • Great home/remote working facilities;

  • Lunch fee;

  • Loads of activities like weekend trips, regular drinks and exciting team activities.

You will join a team that strongly values diversity and cooperation and you will experience a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.

Do you see yourself as the next Ocktonian? Then apply!

Want to know more about Ockto and our hiring process? Nice, below you can read more.

About our organisation

At Ockto, we work in a flat organisational structure with short lines and quick decisions. We work based on trust and responsibility within your own area of work. This gives you the flexibility to do your work under the best conditions for you. From the early days on, working at Ockto has been characterised by a very pleasant working atmosphere. With a lot of attention for good team spirit.

Our aim is to become the market standard platform for the secure, trusted and easily sharing of personal data in every country we operate in. Our Naarden based team already contains a variety of nationalities, and we hope to extend this even further when rolling out to other European countries in the coming years.

More about our company culture and core values.

Do you want to join us?

Do you see yourself as the next Ocktonian?

After your application, we will contact you within five working days to discuss the vacancy, tell you more about our recruitment process and to answer any questions you may have.

Would you first like to know more about the position and working at Ockto? Feel free to contact us! You can reach us via https://ockto.recruitee.com for more information, or other job openings at Ockto.

Your data is safe

At Ockto we only use your motivational letter and CV during the application procedure to assess your application. If you are rejected,

in the context of the GDPR, we will keep your application data for 4 weeks after termination of the application procedure without consent.

Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.


What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.

What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description:
Your job

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples of the ‘everyday’ challenges you would encounter are and have to implement:

  • low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

  • context-switch-free code

  • design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

  • data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

  • complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

  • reimplement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.


Who are you

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

  • extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

  • an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write

  • understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

  • knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

  • understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

  • ability to work with debuggers and profilers

  • operative coding (git, documentation)

  • ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

  • pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

  • experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations;

  • experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases.


What we offer

  • Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus)

  • Fun and inspiring work environment

  • Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues

  • 25 vacation days

  • Allowance for commuting expenses

  • Additional benefits: yearly office trip(s), fitness allowance, Friday afternoon drinks, weekly massages, excellent free lunch

  • Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online.   • Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success.

title: Robot Transporter (C Driver)
description:
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there.

We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes.

Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C-licence box truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them.

This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built.

What you'll do

  • Drive. Operate our leased C-licence box truck and our B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it.

  • Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own.

  • Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely.

  • Run deployment logistics. Systems, kits and operational tools out to a new site before the team arrives, back to the workshop when a build wraps, and everything in between.

  • Keep the fleet where it's useful. Move idle systems from one site to another that needs them, and bring systems back for repair so that a broken robot swapped today is a wall going up tomorrow.

  • Own the vehicles. Servicing, inspections, cleaning, fuel, damage reporting and fines. Vehicles are always road-ready.

  • Log every move. Each transport is recorded in our fleet tooling so deployment managers see when their request is planned and the company always knows where every system and kit is.

  • Improve the process. Feed what you see on the road back to the inventory team (packing standards), deployment team (equipment ratios per site) and the team building our transport tooling.

  • Help with inventory in downtime. When there's nothing to move, you work with the inventory team to prepare kits, organise stock and check returned equipment back in.

What we're looking for

  • A valid C licence with Code 95 and a driver card (bestuurderskaart) (required).

  • Professional driving and load securing experience (required). Trucks, ideally box trucks with tail lift, with real responsibility for what was in the back: lashing, weight distribution, awkward loads. Equipment rental, construction logistics, removals or last-mile delivery are all good backgrounds.

  • Comfortable with physical work. Loading heavy systems with the right equipment, early starts, all weather, construction site conditions. You don’t need a robotics or construction background, but you should want to know how the systems you’re moving work.

title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for one or more mechanical systems on a CS-23 aircraft programme.

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern.

Unsere Technologie

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung.

Kurz gesagt, wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator

What you can expect:

As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless and welcoming experience for candidates and keeping our Talent Acquisition operations running smoothly. You’ll coordinate interviews, maintain accurate information in Ashby and support the production of regular Talent Acquisition reporting. You’ll also work with colleagues across Talent to support supplier administration and help organise our monthly induction for new joiners.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment, cares about getting the details right and wants every interaction with ClearBank to leave a positive impression.

Your role includes:

  • Complete the day-to-day administration of Ashby, maintaining accurate and complete candidate, vacancy and recruitment information to support reliable reporting and compliant hiring processes.

  • Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, managing candidate and interviewer communication and availability to create a timely, organised and professional experience.

  • Welcome and support candidates attending interviews at the ClearBank office, particularly senior candidates, creating a positive and professional first impression.

  • Monitor recruitment activity and data quality in Ashby, identifying missing, inaccurate or outdated information and working with recruiters to resolve issues promptly.

  • Produce accurate weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards and insights, providing clear visibility of recruitment activity and data to the Talent Acquisition Lead.

  • Support wider Talent operations, including supplier onboarding and offboarding for the Head of Talent and the organisation of monthly new-joiner induction with the Talent Development Manager.

  • Identify opportunities to improve Talent Acquisition coordination and administration, suggesting practical ways to make processes simpler, clearer and more effective.

What does success in this role look like:

  • Ashby contains accurate, complete and dependable recruitment information that the Talent Acquisition team can confidently use for reporting and decision-making.

  • Candidates experience organised, timely and thoughtful communication throughout interview coordination and when visiting the ClearBank office.

  • Interviews are coordinated effectively across stakeholders and time zones, with scheduling problems identified and resolved promptly.

  • Weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards are produced accurately and consistently, giving the Talent Acquisition Lead clear visibility of recruitment activity.

  • Supplier administration and monthly induction coordination are organised and reliable, with the relevant stakeholders kept informed.

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Previous experience in a Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or similar role, with hands-on experience supporting interview scheduling, candidate administration and day-to-day recruitment processes.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple interviews, activities and competing priorities.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with recruitment systems, schedules, reports and confidential information.

  • Confidence communicating with candidates and colleagues at different levels of seniority.

  • The ability to use digital systems effectively and learn new technology and processes quickly.

  • A methodical approach to maintaining accurate records and identifying missing or inconsistent information.

  • The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks, follow agreed processes and ask for support when needed.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

People Leadership & Team Development:

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Target start date: March 1, 2027

Compensation: 70,000 to 85,000 EUR yearly gross, depending on profile

Location: Either in-office in Paris (Grands Boulevards, 75002) or full remote on Paris timezone

 
 

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io.

For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow

About the role

You’ll join a small, efficient team who builds high-impact features for our users. You'll work on a wide range of topics, including AI agents, workflow automations, analytics, or payment processing. We invest significantly in AI features, and you'll play a key role in making Upflow the leading agentic software in our field.

We work at a fast pace, averaging 20 deploys to production each day, but with high quality standards, and we value pragmatism, ownership, and a growth mindset.

AI is also transforming how we work, and we're looking for someone eager to use and optimize agents to help us work more efficiently.

You can be based in our Paris office or work remotely.

What you will do

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Architect and implement complex, high-impact product features from start-to-finish.

  • Collaborate closely with the product manager, the designer, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Ship clean, maintainable code to production daily.

  • Participate actively in technical reviews providing and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Troubleshoot and debug complex product issues.

  • Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

  • Help improve our agentic tools and automations.

Our current stack

  • Frontend: Typescript, React, GraphQL

  • Backend: Typescript, Node.js, Express, Postgres, and Redis

  • Infra: GCP, Terraform

  • Observability: Datadog and Sentry

  • Github, Copilot, Claude Code, CircleCI

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering.

  • You have strong proficiency in Typescript, React and SQL.

  • You’re proficient at working with agentic coding assistant such as Claude Code.

  • You have strong skills in architecture, software reliability, and scalability

  • You have a product sensibility and care about UX.

  • You have good teamwork skills and enjoy providing and receiving feedback.

  • You want to work in a startup environment that values excellence, autonomy, and ownership.

  • You are fluent in English with strong communication skills.

  • You are based in Paris, or live in Paris timezone

Why join us

  • International mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • On-site or full remote: On-site job in Paris (2-3 days in office), or full remote position on Paris timezone (1 monthly visit in our Paris office).

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to contribute to the Engineering function in the AI era.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem.

Recruitment Process

1 - Screening call

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

2 - Take home assignment

It’s a coding exercise that can only be completed successfully with the help of AI. In addition to delivering working software that meets the requirements, you’ll be evaluated on your product and architectural decisions.

3 - Technical interview

In this interview, we’ll review your take-home assignment and discuss how you approach designing scalable systems and making architectural decisions.

4 - Meet the team!

You’ll also meet up with at least two other peers so you can foresee yourself as part of this team.

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Alignment and offer

If the team meetings go well on both sides, we’ll invite you to this final step. Getting here means we both see a strong fit and believe Upflow is a place where you can grow and shine over the next few years. We’ll align on how you’ll join us (role scope, start date, package), and if we’re all on the same page, we’ll extend you an offer!

 

*****

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

title: Amazon Performance (PPC) & Automation Manager
description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

Amazon brings Ledger to a broader audience of crypto-curious buyers on every continent, making it a key growth driver for the business. The Marketplaces team owns the Amazon channel end to end, from catalogue and inventory management to ads campaign management. You’ll lead our ads performance and bring a builder’s mindset to the whole channel: using data and AI to scale what works and automate our Amazon processes, from ads to operations.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Amazon advertising management: own and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display and DSP campaigns across our markets, with one goal: prove and drive incremental revenue, not just efficient spend; use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) to understand our audiences and buyers and measure what our ads really bring.

  • Process automation: rebuild our largely manual Amazon workflows (bid management, reporting, budget pacing, promo checks) into automated, scalable processes, leveraging AI tools and scripting rather than spreadsheets.

  • Data & reporting: collaborate closely with the data team to build and maintain dashboards and trackers monitoring ads performance and promotional impact, turning raw data into clear recommendations for leadership.

  • Promotions: manage promotional calendars across marketplaces to maximize conversion and defend competitive position.

  • Tooling & partner evaluation: continuously benchmark and test third party tools, agencies and tech partners (audiences analytics, competitive intelligence, etc.) to identify the best stack for scale.

  • Cross functional collaboration: work closely with the operations/catalog team, brand, and finance teams to align ads strategy with inventory, listings, and budget realities.

What we’re looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience in performance marketing or data analysis, or, with a strong analytical mindset (Amazon Ads experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • Strong appetite for AI is a must, with dashboards, reportings or automated processes you’ve built using AI tools

  • Comfortable owning manual workflows and turning them into repeatable systems

  • Excellent organizational skills

  • Fluent in English; the role is based in Paris, and English is a prerequisite for both social and work life in our office

Nice to have:

  • Hands on experience with Amazon Ads console / Seller Central / Vendor Central

  • Interest in Web3/crypto

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown
description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

  • A deep interest in game development is a plus.

  • Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
  • Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.

Requirements

Indispensable

  • Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
  • Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

  • Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

  • Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
  • Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
  • Expérience en pression ou température.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié.
  • Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés.
  • Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise.

Conditions

Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement
Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Help us build an in-house accounting function from the ground up. trawa is bringing its bookkeeping in-house, and you'll be one of the people who makes that work: clean books, on time, every month.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth energy-tech company with strong team growth, backed by Balderton Capital, Speedinvest and Headline. Our business model sits at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, which makes our accounting more complex and more interesting than a typical start-up ledger.

You'll start hands-on with day-to-day accounting and keep the books clean as volumes grow. At the same time, you'll spot the manual steps in your work and get room to automate them. You'll also be part of our ERP rollout. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own their area, not just process it.

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Process, check, and post incoming invoices from Moss into DATEV, including correct VAT treatment

  • Handle expenses and credit card bookings

  • Maintain vendor master data and keep supplier accounts reconciled

  • Prepare payment runs

Month-End Support

  • Reconcile bank transactions

  • Prepare accruals and reconciliations for your areas

  • Support the monthly close and year-end, working with our auditors

  • Keep documentation GoBD-compliant and audit-ready

  • Partner with Ops, Procurement and budget owners to resolve invoice and cost questions

Build & Improve

  • Spot manual steps in your processes and automate them

  • Contribute to our ERP rollout



Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in accounts payable

  • Comfortable when processes don't exist yet. You help create them instead of waiting for them

  • Solid understanding of German GAAP (HGB) and VAT basics

  • Precise and fast. You care about getting it right and getting it done

  • Analytical and confident in Excel or Google Sheets for reconciliations

  • Fluent in English

Nice-to-haves

  • German is a strong plus (B1 or better): most of our vendor invoices and much of our supplier communication are in German

  • Experience in a fast-growing company (start-up or scale-up), or at a tax firm serving start-up clients

  • Hands-on with DATEV Rechnungswesen and DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO)

  • Training as Steuerfachangestellte/r or Kaufmann/-frau

  • Experience with Moss or similar spend management tools

  • Automation experience or strong tech curiosity: you've built workflows with n8n, Zapier, or Make, or used Claude Code or similar AI tools

Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Learn

  • Understand our business model, our accounting setup, and our tools (Moss, DATEV). Take over your first recurring bookings.

Month 2: Own

  • Run accounts payable and bank postings independently. Support your first month-end close.

Month 3: Improve

  • Deliver your areas on time each month. Propose and ship your first automation or process improvement.

The Team

You'll join a fast-growing Finance team of around ten people across Accounting, Billing, Collections, FP&A, Treasury, and Strategic Finance. You'll work closely with colleagues across these areas and see how your bookings flow into cash and planning. You'll also work cross-functionally with Business Operations, Energy, and other departments.

  • Real ownership from day one. You build the accounting function from the start, not just maintain one
